verses.transliteration: Afaman zuyyina lahu sooo AAamalihi faraahu hasanan fainna Allaha yudillu man yashao wayahdee man yashao fala tathhab nafsuka AAalayhim hasaratin inna Allaha AAaleemun bima yasnaAAoona
verses.translation: Then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]? For indeed, Allāh sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. So do not let yourself perish over them in regret. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of what they do.

verses.text: وَٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابٗا فَسُقۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٖ مَّيِّتٖ فَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verses.transliteration: WaAllahu allathee arsala alrriyaha fatutheeru sahaban fasuqnahu ila baladin mayyitin faahyayna bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha kathalika alnnushooru
verses.translation: And it is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds, and We drive them to a dead land and give life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Thus is the resurrection.

verses.text: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًاۚ إِلَيۡهِ يَصۡعَدُ ٱلۡكَلِمُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ وَٱلۡعَمَلُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُ يَرۡفَعُهُۥۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَمۡكُرُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدٞۖ وَمَكۡرُ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ
verses.transliteration: Man kana yureedu alAAizzata falillahi alAAizzatu jameeAAan ilayhi yasAAadu alkalimu alttayyibu waalAAamalu alssalihu yarfaAAuhu waallatheena yamkuroona alssayyiati lahum AAathabun shadeedun wamakru olaika huwa yabooru
verses.translation: Whoever desires honor [through power] - then to Allāh belongs all honor.[1245] To Him ascends good speech, and righteous work raises it.[1246] But they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish.
verses.footnotes:
[1245] See footnote to 4:139.
[1246] For acceptance by Allāh, meaning that righteous deeds are confirmation and proof of what is uttered by the tongue.

verses.text: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗاۚ وَمَا تَحۡمِلُ مِنۡ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلۡمِهِۦۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٖ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنۡ عُمُرِهِۦٓ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبٍۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٞ
verses.transliteration: WaAllahu khalaqakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma jaAAalakum azwajan wama tahmilu min ontha wala tadaAAu illa biAAilmihi wama yuAAammaru min muAAammarin wala yunqasu min AAumurihi illa fee kitabin inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun
verses.translation: And Allāh created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop; then He made you mates. And no female conceives nor does she give birth except with His knowledge. And no aged person is granted [additional] life nor is his lifespan lessened but that it is in a register. Indeed, that for Allāh is easy.

verses.text: وَمَا يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡبَحۡرَانِ هَٰذَا عَذۡبٞ فُرَاتٞ سَآئِغٞ شَرَابُهُۥ وَهَٰذَا مِلۡحٌ أُجَاجٞۖ وَمِن كُلّٖ تَأۡكُلُونَ لَحۡمٗا طَرِيّٗا وَتَسۡتَخۡرِجُونَ حِلۡيَةٗ تَلۡبَسُونَهَاۖ وَتَرَى ٱلۡفُلۡكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wama yastawee albahrani hatha AAathbun furatun saighun sharabuhu wahatha milhun ojajun wamin kullin takuloona lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoona hilyatan talbasoonaha watara alfulka feehi mawakhira litabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona
verses.translation: And not alike are the two seas [i.e., bodies of water]. One is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter. And from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through [them] that you might seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

verses.text: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِن قِطۡمِيرٍ
verses.transliteration: Yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku waallatheena tadAAoona min doonihi ma yamlikoona min qitmeerin
verses.translation: He causes the night to enter the day, and He causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running [its course] for a specified term. That is Allāh, your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty. And those whom you invoke other than Him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed.

verses.text: إِن تَدۡعُوهُمۡ لَا يَسۡمَعُواْ دُعَآءَكُمۡ وَلَوۡ سَمِعُواْ مَا ٱسۡتَجَابُواْ لَكُمۡۖ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يَكۡفُرُونَ بِشِرۡكِكُمۡۚ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثۡلُ خَبِيرٖ
verses.transliteration: In tadAAoohum la yasmaAAoo duAAaakum walaw samiAAoo ma istajaboo lakum wayawma alqiyamati yakfuroona bishirkikum wala yunabbioka mithlu khabeerin
verses.translation: If you invoke them, they do not hear your supplication; and if they heard, they would not respond to you. And on the Day of Resurrection they will deny your association.[1247] And none can inform you like [one] Aware [of all matters].
verses.footnotes: [1247] Of them with Allāh or your worship of them.

verses.text: ۞يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلۡفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ
verses.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnasu antumu alfuqarao ila Allahi waAllahu huwa alghaniyyu alhameedu
verses.translation: O mankind, you are those in need of Allāh, while Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

verses.text: إِن يَشَأۡ يُذۡهِبۡكُمۡ وَيَأۡتِ بِخَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٖ
verses.transliteration: In yasha yuthhibkum wayati bikhalqin jadeedin
verses.translation: If He wills, He can do away with you and bring forth a new creation.

verses.text: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٖ
verses.transliteration: Wama thalika AAala Allahi biAAazeezin
verses.translation: And that is for Allāh not difficult.

verses.text: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ وَإِن تَدۡعُ مُثۡقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمۡلِهَا لَا يُحۡمَلۡ مِنۡهُ شَيۡءٞ وَلَوۡ كَانَ ذَا قُرۡبَىٰٓۗ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra wain tadAAu muthqalatun ila himliha la yuhmal minhu shayon walaw kana tha qurba innama tunthiru allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi waaqamoo alssalata waman tazakka fainnama yatazakka linafsihi waila Allahi almaseeru
verses.translation: And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And if a heavily laden soul calls [another] to [carry some of] its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if he should be a close relative. You can only warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer. And whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul. And to Allāh is the [final] destination.

verses.text: وَمَا يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ وَٱلۡبَصِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Wama yastawee alaAAma waalbaseeru
verses.translation: Not equal are the blind and the seeing,

verses.text: وَلَا ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَلَا ٱلنُّورُ
verses.transliteration: Wala alththulumatu wala alnnooru
verses.translation: Nor are the darknesses and the light,

verses.text: وَلَا ٱلظِّلُّ وَلَا ٱلۡحَرُورُ
verses.transliteration: Wala alththillu wala alharooru
verses.translation: Nor are the shade and the heat,[1248]
verses.footnotes: [1248] Of the sun or of a scorching wind.

verses.text: وَمَا يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡأَحۡيَآءُ وَلَا ٱلۡأَمۡوَٰتُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسۡمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسۡمِعٖ مَّن فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
verses.transliteration: Wama yastawee alahyao wala alamwatu inna Allaha yusmiAAu man yashao wama anta bimusmiAAin man fee alquboori
verses.translation: And not equal are the living and the dead. Indeed, Allāh causes to hear whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.[1249]
verses.footnotes: [1249] The four comparisons given by Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) in verses 19-22 are those of the believer and unbeliever, various kinds of misbelief and (true) belief, Paradise and Hellfire, and those receptive to guidance and those unreceptive.

verses.text: إِنۡ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ
verses.transliteration: In anta illa natheerun
verses.translation: You, [O Muḥammad], are not but a warner.

verses.text: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗاۚ وَإِن مِّنۡ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٞ
verses.transliteration: Inna arsalnaka bialhaqqi basheeran wanatheeran wain min ommatin illa khala feeha natheerun
verses.translation: Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner.

verses.text: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَبِٱلزُّبُرِ وَبِٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُنِيرِ
verses.transliteration: Wain yukaththibooka faqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim jaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati wabialzzuburi wabialkitabi almuneeri
verses.translation: And if they deny you - then already have those before them denied. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs and written ordinances and with the enlightening Scripture.

verses.text: ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.transliteration: Thumma akhathtu allatheena kafaroo fakayfa kana nakeeri
verses.translation: Then I seized the ones who disbelieved, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

verses.text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٖ مُّخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهَاۚ وَمِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ جُدَدُۢ بِيضٞ وَحُمۡرٞ مُّخۡتَلِفٌ أَلۡوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٞ
verses.transliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi thamaratin mukhtalifan alwanuha wamina aljibali judadun beedun wahumrun mukhtalifun alwanuha wagharabeebu soodun
verses.translation: Do you not see that Allāh sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby fruits of varying colors? And in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and [some] extremely black.

verses.text: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ مُخۡتَلِفٌ أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَۗ إِنَّمَا يَخۡشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِ ٱلۡعُلَمَـٰٓؤُاْۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ
verses.transliteration: Wamina alnnasi waalddawabbi waalanAAami mukhtalifun alwanuhu kathalika innama yakhsha Allaha min AAibadihi alAAulamao inna Allaha AAazeezun ghafoorun
verses.translation: And among people and moving creatures and grazing livestock are various colors similarly. Only those fear Allāh, from among His servants, who have knowledge. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Forgiving.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتۡلُونَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ سِرّٗا وَعَلَانِيَةٗ يَرۡجُونَ تِجَٰرَةٗ لَّن تَبُورَ
verses.transliteration: Inna allatheena yatloona kitaba Allahi waaqamoo alssalata waanfaqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran waAAalaniyatan yarjoona tijaratan lan taboora
verses.translation: Indeed, those who recite the Book of Allāh and establish prayer and spend [in His cause] out of what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, [can] expect a transaction [i.e., profit] that will never perish -

verses.text: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمۡ أُجُورَهُمۡ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٞ شَكُورٞ
verses.transliteration: Liyuwaffiyahum ojoorahum wayazeedahum min fadlihi innahu ghafoorun shakoorun
verses.translation: That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.[1250]
verses.footnotes: [1250] i.e., He gives much in return for little and multiplies rewards.

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرُۢ بَصِيرٞ
verses.transliteration: Waallathee awhayna ilayka mina alkitabi huwa alhaqqu musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi inna Allaha biAAibadihi lakhabeerun baseerun
verses.translation: And that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], of the Book is the truth, confirming what was before it. Indeed Allāh, of His servants, is Aware and Seeing.

verses.text: ثُمَّ أَوۡرَثۡنَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصۡطَفَيۡنَا مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاۖ فَمِنۡهُمۡ ظَالِمٞ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ وَمِنۡهُم مُّقۡتَصِدٞ وَمِنۡهُمۡ سَابِقُۢ بِٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Thumma awrathna alkitaba allatheena istafayna min AAibadina faminhum thalimun linafsihi waminhum muqtasidun waminhum sabiqun bialkhayrati biithni Allahi thalika huwa alfadlu alkabeeru
verses.translation: Then We caused to inherit the Book those We have chosen of Our servants;[1251] and among them is he who wrongs himself [i.e., sins], and among them is he who is moderate, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by permission of Allāh. That [inheritance] is what is the great bounty.
verses.footnotes: [1251] The followers of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).

verses.text: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدۡنٖ يَدۡخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوۡنَ فِيهَا مِنۡ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٖ وَلُؤۡلُؤٗاۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمۡ فِيهَا حَرِيرٞ
verses.transliteration: Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonaha yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin waluluan walibasuhum feeha hareerun
verses.translation: [For them are] gardens of perpetual residence which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.

verses.text: وَقَالُواْ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَذۡهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلۡحَزَنَۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٞ شَكُورٌ
verses.transliteration: Waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee athhaba AAanna alhazana inna rabbana laghafoorun shakoorun
verses.translation: And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -

verses.text: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلۡمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٞ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٞ
verses.transliteration: Allathee ahallana dara almuqamati min fadlihi la yamassuna feeha nasabun wala yamassuna feeha lughoobun
verses.translation: He who has settled us in the home of duration [i.e., Paradise] out of His bounty. There touches us not in it any fatigue, and there touches us not in it weariness [of mind]."

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَهُمۡ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقۡضَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ فَيَمُوتُواْ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِهَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي كُلَّ كَفُورٖ
verses.transliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo lahum naru jahannama la yuqda AAalayhim fayamootoo wala yukhaffafu AAanhum min AAathabiha kathalika najzee kulla kafoorin
verses.translation: And for those who disbelieve will be the fire of Hell. [Death] is not decreed for them[1252] so they may die, nor will its torment be lightened for them. Thus do We recompense every ungrateful one.
verses.footnotes: [1252] Or "They are not killed."

verses.text: وَهُمۡ يَصۡطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا نَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحًا غَيۡرَ ٱلَّذِي كُنَّا نَعۡمَلُۚ أَوَلَمۡ نُعَمِّرۡكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُۖ فَذُوقُواْ فَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
verses.transliteration: Wahum yastarikhoona feeha rabbana akhrijna naAAmal salihan ghayra allathee kunna naAAmalu awalam nuAAammirkum ma yatathakkaru feehi man tathakkara wajaakumu alnnatheeru fathooqoo fama lilththalimeena min naseerin
verses.translation: And they will cry out therein, "Our Lord, remove us;[1253] we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!" But did We not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember, and the warner had come to you? So taste [the punishment], for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper.
verses.footnotes: [1253] The implication is "Return us to the previous world."

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَٰلِمُ غَيۡبِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.transliteration: Inna Allaha AAalimu ghaybi alssamawati waalardi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori
verses.translation: Indeed, Allāh is Knower of the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

verses.text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَكُمۡ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيۡهِ كُفۡرُهُۥۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ كُفۡرُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا مَقۡتٗاۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ كُفۡرُهُمۡ إِلَّا خَسَارٗا
verses.transliteration: Huwa allathee jaAAalakum khalaifa fee alardi faman kafara faAAalayhi kufruhu wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum AAinda rabbihim illa maqtan wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum illa khasaran
verses.translation: It is He who has made you successors upon the earth. And whoever disbelieves - upon him will be [the consequence of] his disbelief. And the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them in the sight of their Lord except in hatred; and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them except in loss.

verses.text: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شِرۡكٞ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَمۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كِتَٰبٗا فَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٖ مِّنۡهُۚ بَلۡ إِن يَعِدُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا
verses.transliteration: Qul araaytum shurakaakumu allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee alssamawati am ataynahum kitaban fahum AAala bayyinatin minhu bal in yaAAidu alththalimoona baAAduhum baAAdan illa ghurooran
verses.translation: Say, "Have you considered[1254] your 'partners' whom you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership [with Him] in the heavens? Or have We given them a book so they are [standing] on evidence therefrom? [No], rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion."[1255]
verses.footnotes:
[1254] Understood to mean "Tell me about..."
[1255] By telling their followers that the so-called deities will intercede for them with Allāh.

verses.text: ۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمۡسِكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ أَن تَزُولَاۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنۡ أَمۡسَكَهُمَا مِنۡ أَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورٗا
verses.transliteration: Inna Allaha yumsiku alssamawati waalarda an tazoola walain zalata in amsakahuma min ahadin min baAAdihi innahu kana haleeman ghafooran
verses.translation: Indeed, Allāh holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing[1256] and Forgiving.
verses.footnotes: [1256] Refer to footnote in 2:225.

verses.text: وَأَقۡسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ جَهۡدَ أَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ لَئِن جَآءَهُمۡ نَذِيرٞ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهۡدَىٰ مِنۡ إِحۡدَى ٱلۡأُمَمِۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ نَذِيرٞ مَّا زَادَهُمۡ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
verses.transliteration: Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim lain jaahum natheerun layakoonunna ahda min ihda alomami falamma jaahum natheerun ma zadahum illa nufooran
verses.translation: And they swore by Allāh their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than [any] one of the [previous] nations. But when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion

verses.text: ٱسۡتِكۡبَارٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَكۡرَ ٱلسَّيِّيِٕۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلۡمَكۡرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهۡلِهِۦۚ فَهَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبۡدِيلٗاۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحۡوِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Istikbaran fee alardi wamakra alssayyii wala yaheequ almakru alssayyio illa biahlihi fahal yanthuroona illa sunnata alawwaleena falan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tahweelan
verses.translation: [Due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. Then do they await except the way [i.e., fate] of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way [i.e., established method] of Allāh any change, and you will never find in the way of Allāh[1257] any alteration.[1258]
verses.footnotes:
[1257] i.e., in His punishment of those who deny the prophets.
[1258] Or "transfer" of punishment to others in place of them.

verses.text: أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ وَكَانُوٓاْ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعۡجِزَهُۥ مِن شَيۡءٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمٗا قَدِيرٗا
verses.transliteration: Awalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim wakanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan wama kana Allahu liyuAAjizahu min shayin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi innahu kana AAaleeman qadeeran
verses.translation: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allāh is not to be caused failure [i.e., prevented] by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.

verses.text: وَلَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُواْ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهۡرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٖ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمۡ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرَۢا
verses.transliteration: Walaw yuakhithu Allahu alnnasa bima kasaboo ma taraka AAala thahriha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum fainna Allaha kana biAAibadihi baseeran
verses.translation: And if Allāh were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allāh has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.

verses.text: يسٓ
verses.transliteration: Yaseen
verses.translation: Yā, Seen.[1260]
verses.footnotes: [1260] See footnote to 2:1.

verses.text: وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Waalqurani alhakeemi
verses.translation: By the wise[1261] Qur’ān,
verses.footnotes: [1261] See footnote to 10:1.

verses.text: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innaka lamina almursaleena
verses.translation: Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,

verses.text: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
verses.transliteration: AAala siratin mustaqeemin
verses.translation: On a straight path.

verses.text: تَنزِيلَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Tanzeela alAAazeezi alrraheemi
verses.translation: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

verses.text: لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمٗا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Litunthira qawman ma onthira abaohum fahum ghafiloona
verses.translation: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.

verses.text: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Laqad haqqa alqawlu AAala aktharihim fahum la yuminoona
verses.translation: Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

verses.text: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ أَغۡلَٰلٗا فَهِيَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَذۡقَانِ فَهُم مُّقۡمَحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Inna jaAAalna fee aAAnaqihim aghlalan fahiya ila alathqani fahum muqmahoona
verses.translation: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.

verses.text: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ سَدّٗا وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدّٗا فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: WajaAAalna min bayni aydeehim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan faaghshaynahum fahum la yubsiroona
verses.translation: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.

verses.text: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wasawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona
verses.translation: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

verses.text: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةٖ وَأَجۡرٖ كَرِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Innama tunthiru mani ittabaAAa alththikra wakhashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfiratin waajrin kareemin
verses.translation: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.

verses.text: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمۡۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ فِيٓ إِمَامٖ مُّبِينٖ
verses.transliteration: Inna nahnu nuhyee almawta wanaktubu ma qaddamoo waatharahum wakulla shayin ahsaynahu fee imamin mubeenin
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.

verses.text: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ إِذۡ جَآءَهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waidrib lahum mathalan ashaba alqaryati ith jaaha almursaloona
verses.translation: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -

verses.text: إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٖ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُم مُّرۡسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ith arsalna ilayhimu ithnayni fakaththaboohuma faAAazzazna bithalithin faqaloo inna ilaykum mursaloona
verses.translation: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."

verses.text: قَالُواْ مَآ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَكۡذِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo ma antum illa basharun mithluna wama anzala alrrahmanu min shayin in antum illa takthiboona
verses.translation: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."

verses.text: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo rabbuna yaAAlamu inna ilaykum lamursaloona
verses.translation: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,

verses.text: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
verses.transliteration: Wama AAalayna illa albalaghu almubeenu
verses.translation: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

verses.text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo inna tatayyarna bikum lain lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minna AAathabun aleemun
verses.translation: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

verses.text: قَالُواْ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمۡ أَئِن ذُكِّرۡتُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٞ مُّسۡرِفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo tairukum maAAakum ain thukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifoona
verses.translation: They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it[1262] because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
verses.footnotes: [1262] Your threat against us.

verses.text: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٞ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wajaa min aqsa almadeenati rajulun yasAAa qala ya qawmi ittabiAAoo almursaleena
verses.translation: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

verses.text: ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ أَجۡرٗا وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: IttabiAAoo man la yasalukum ajran wahum muhtadoona
verses.translation: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.

verses.text: وَمَالِيَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wama liya la aAAbudu allathee fataranee wailayhi turjaAAoona
verses.translation: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?

verses.text: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدۡنِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ بِضُرّٖ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
verses.transliteration: Aattakhithu min doonihi alihatan in yuridni alrrahmanu bidurrin la tughni AAannee shafaAAatuhum shayan wala yunqithooni
verses.translation: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?

verses.text: إِنِّيٓ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Innee ithan lafee dalalin mubeenin
verses.translation: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

verses.text: إِنِّيٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَٱسۡمَعُونِ
verses.transliteration: Innee amantu birabbikum faismaAAooni
verses.translation: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."

verses.text: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلِ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِي يَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qeela odkhuli aljannata qala ya layta qawmee yaAAlamoona
verses.translation: It was said, "Enter Paradise."[1263] He said, "I wish my people could know
verses.footnotes: [1263] An abrupt transfer to the Hereafter conveys the meaning that the man met a violent death at the hands of the disbelievers and so was martyred for the cause of Allāh.

verses.text: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Bima ghafara lee rabbee wajaAAalanee mina almukrameena
verses.translation: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."

verses.text: ۞وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِن جُندٖ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wama anzalna AAala qawmihi min baAAdihi min jundin mina alssamai wama kunna munzileena
verses.translation: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

verses.text: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ خَٰمِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum khamidoona
verses.translation: It was not but one shout,[1264] and immediately they were extinguished.
verses.footnotes: [1264] From Gabriel or a blast from the sky.

verses.text: يَٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى ٱلۡعِبَادِۚ مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ya hasratan AAala alAAibadi ma yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
verses.translation: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.

verses.text: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni annahum ilayhim la yarjiAAoona
verses.translation: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them[1265] will not return?
verses.footnotes: [1265] i.e., to those living presently in the world.

verses.text: وَإِن كُلّٞ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wain kullun lamma jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona
verses.translation: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

verses.text: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ أَحۡيَيۡنَٰهَا وَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبّٗا فَمِنۡهُ يَأۡكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waayatun lahumu alardu almaytatu ahyaynaha waakhrajna minha habban faminhu yakuloona
verses.translation: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.

verses.text: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٖ مِّن نَّخِيلٖ وَأَعۡنَٰبٖ وَفَجَّرۡنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡعُيُونِ
verses.transliteration: WajaAAalna feeha jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin wafajjarna feeha mina alAAuyooni
verses.translation: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -

verses.text: لِيَأۡكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Liyakuloo min thamarihi wama AAamilathu aydeehim afala yashkuroona
verses.translation: That they may eat of His fruit.[1266] And their hands have not produced it,[1267] so will they not be grateful?
verses.footnotes:
[1266] i.e., that which Allāh has produced for them.
[1267] An alternative meaning is "And [eat from] what their hands have produced [i.e., planted and harvested]." Both are grammatically correct.

verses.text: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Subhana allathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu alardu wamin anfusihim wamimma la yaAAlamoona
verses.translation: Exalted is He who created all pairs[1268] - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
verses.footnotes: [1268] Or "all species."

verses.text: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيۡلُ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظۡلِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waayatun lahumu allaylu naslakhu minhu alnnahara faitha hum muthlimoona
verses.translation: And a sign for them is the night. We remove[1269] from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
verses.footnotes: [1269] Literally, "strip" or "peel." Sunlight projected onto the earth is removed from it as the earth turns and night approaches.

verses.text: وَٱلشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرّٖ لَّهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Waalshshamsu tajree limustaqarrin laha thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi
verses.translation: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

verses.text: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Waalqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta AAada kaalAAurjooni alqadeemi
verses.translation: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

verses.text: لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِي لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَكُلّٞ فِي فَلَكٖ يَسۡبَحُونَ
verses.transliteration: La alshshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu alnnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoona
verses.translation: It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

verses.text: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
verses.transliteration: Waayatun lahum anna hamalna thurriyyatahum fee alfulki almashhooni
verses.translation: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers[1270] in a laden ship.
verses.footnotes: [1270] Usually meaning "descendants" or "offspring," the word "dhurriyyah" is used here to denote forefathers (their being the offspring of Noah), who were saved from the flood.

verses.text: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ مَا يَرۡكَبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wakhalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkaboona
verses.translation: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

verses.text: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wain nasha nughriqhum fala sareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoona
verses.translation: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

verses.text: إِلَّا رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
verses.transliteration: Illa rahmatan minna wamataAAan ila heenin
verses.translation: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

verses.text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُواْ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waitha qeela lahumu ittaqoo ma bayna aydeekum wama khalfakum laAAallakum turhamoona
verses.translation: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you;[1271] perhaps you will receive mercy..."[1272]
verses.footnotes:
[1271] Of sins or of life in this world and the Hereafter.
[1272] The conclusion of this sentence is understood to be "...they ignored the warning."

verses.text: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٖ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideena
verses.translation: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

verses.text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنُطۡعِمُ مَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطۡعَمَهُۥٓ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
verses.transliteration: Waitha qeela lahum anfiqoo mimma razaqakumu Allahu qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo anutAAimu man law yashao Allahu atAAamahu in antum illa fee dalalin mubeenin
verses.translation: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allāh has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allāh had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."

verses.text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena
verses.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

verses.text: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ تَأۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ma yanthuroona illa sayhatan wahidatan takhuthuhum wahum yakhissimoona
verses.translation: They do not await except one blast[1273] which will seize them while they are disputing.
verses.footnotes: [1273] Literally, "cry" or "shriek," meaning the first blast of the Horn which will strike dead every living thing on the earth without warning.

verses.text: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ تَوۡصِيَةٗ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fala yastateeAAoona tawsiyatan wala ila ahlihim yarjiAAoona
verses.translation: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.

verses.text: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَنسِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wanufikha fee alssoori faitha hum mina alajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloona
verses.translation: And the Horn will be blown;[1274] and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
verses.footnotes: [1274] For the second time, signaling the Resurrection.

verses.text: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرۡقَدِنَاۜۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo ya waylana man baAAathana min marqadina hatha ma waAAada alrrahmanu wasadaqa almursaloona
verses.translation: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

verses.text: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona
verses.translation: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.

verses.text: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faalyawma la tuthlamu nafsun shayan wala tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona
verses.translation: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.

verses.text: إِنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي شُغُلٖ فَٰكِهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Inna ashaba aljannati alyawma fee shughulin fakihoona
verses.translation: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -

verses.text: هُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُمۡ فِي ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
verses.transliteration: Hum waazwajuhum fee thilalin AAala alaraiki muttakioona
verses.translation: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

verses.text: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lahum feeha fakihatun walahum ma yaddaAAoona
verses.translation: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

verses.text: سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡلٗا مِّن رَّبّٖ رَّحِيمٖ
verses.transliteration: Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheemin
verses.translation: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

verses.text: وَٱمۡتَٰزُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waimtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoona
verses.translation: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.[1275]
verses.footnotes: [1275] i.e., remove yourself from the ranks of the believers to be distinguished from them.

verses.text: ۞أَلَمۡ أَعۡهَدۡ إِلَيۡكُمۡ يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعۡبُدُواْ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.transliteration: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun
verses.translation: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

verses.text: وَأَنِ ٱعۡبُدُونِيۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
verses.transliteration: Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratun mustaqeemun
verses.translation: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمۡ جِبِلّٗا كَثِيرًاۖ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُونُواْ تَعۡقِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloona
verses.translation: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?

verses.text: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum tooAAadoona
verses.translation: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.

verses.text: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroona
verses.translation: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."[1276]
verses.footnotes: [1276] Or "because you used to disbelieve."

verses.text: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ أَرۡجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboona
verses.translation: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.

verses.text: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَٱسۡتَبَقُواْ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبۡصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaw nashao latamasna AAala aAAyunihim faistabaqoo alssirata faanna yubsiroona
verses.translation: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?[1277]
verses.footnotes: [1277] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) could have left man without means of guidance in the life of this world, although in His mercy He did not.

verses.text: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مُضِيّٗا وَلَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum AAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyan wala yarjiAAoona
verses.translation: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.[1278]
verses.footnotes: [1278] He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) could have prevented man from taking any action to benefit himself in this world or the Hereafter, yet He did not.

verses.text: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِۚ أَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala yaAAqiloona
verses.translation: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation;[1279] so will they not understand?
verses.footnotes: [1279] In his physical and mental capacity.

verses.text: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ وَقُرۡءَانٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.transliteration: Wama AAallamnahu alshshiAAra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrun waquranun mubeenun
verses.translation: And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān

verses.text: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيّٗا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireena
verses.translation: To warn whoever is alive[1280] and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.
verses.footnotes: [1280] In heart and mind, i.e., the believers.

verses.text: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahum laha malikoona
verses.translation: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands[1281] have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
verses.footnotes: [1281] See footnote to 2:19.

verses.text: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wathallalnaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloona
verses.translation: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.

verses.text: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibu afala yashkuroona
verses.translation: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?

verses.text: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةٗ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan laAAallahum yunsaroona
verses.translation: But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.

verses.text: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّحۡضَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: La yastateeAAoona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroona
verses.translation: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.[1282]
verses.footnotes: [1282] Maintaining and protecting their "gods." Another interpretation is that they (i.e., the gods) will be soldiers set against them in Hellfire.

verses.text: فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna naAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona
verses.translation: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.

verses.text: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.transliteration: Awalam yara alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun
verses.translation: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once[1283] he is a clear adversary?
verses.footnotes: [1283] i.e., as soon as he becomes self-sufficient.

verses.text: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلٗا وَنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَن يُحۡيِ ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٞ
verses.transliteration: Wadaraba lana mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithama wahiya rameemun
verses.translation: And he presents for Us an example[1284] and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
verses.footnotes: [1284] Attempting to establish the finality of death.

verses.text: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Qul yuhyeeha allathee anshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleemun
verses.translation: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارٗا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Allathee jaAAala lakum mina alshshajari alakhdari naran faitha antum minhu tooqidoona
verses.translation: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.

verses.text: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Awalaysa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu
verses.translation: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

verses.text: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.transliteration: Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu
verses.translation: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.

verses.text: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fasubhana allathee biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wailayhi turjaAAoona
verses.translation: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.

verses.text: وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفّٗا
verses.transliteration: Waalssaffati saffan
verses.translation: By those [angels] lined up in rows

verses.text: فَٱلزَّـٰجِرَٰتِ زَجۡرٗا
verses.transliteration: Faalzzajirati zajran
verses.translation: And those who drive [the clouds]

verses.text: فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا
verses.transliteration: Faalttaliyati thikran
verses.translation: And those who recite the message,[1286]
verses.footnotes: [1286] To the prophets or among themselves. Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) swears by these three kinds of angels to the fact mentioned in the following verse.

verses.text: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمۡ لَوَٰحِدٞ
verses.transliteration: Inna ilahakum lawahidun
verses.translation: Indeed, your God is One,

verses.text: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ
verses.transliteration: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma warabbu almashariqi
verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.[1287]
verses.footnotes: [1287] i.e., each point or place of sunrise.

verses.text: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
verses.transliteration: Inna zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bizeenatin alkawakibi
verses.translation: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

verses.text: وَحِفۡظٗا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ مَّارِدٖ
verses.transliteration: Wahifthan min kulli shaytanin maridin
verses.translation: And as protection against every rebellious devil

verses.text: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٖ
verses.transliteration: La yassammaAAoona ila almalai alaAAla wayuqthafoona min kulli janibin
verses.translation: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,[1288]
verses.footnotes: [1288] By flaming meteors.

verses.text: دُحُورٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ وَاصِبٌ
verses.transliteration: Duhooran walahum AAathabun wasibun
verses.translation: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

verses.text: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ ثَاقِبٞ
verses.transliteration: Illa man khatifa alkhatfata faatbaAAahu shihabun thaqibun
verses.translation: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].

verses.text: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٖ لَّازِبِۭ
verses.transliteration: Faistaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqna inna khalaqnahum min teenin lazibin
verses.translation: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.

verses.text: بَلۡ عَجِبۡتَ وَيَسۡخَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Bal AAajibta wayaskharoona
verses.translation: But you wonder, while they mock,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ لَا يَذۡكُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waitha thukkiroo la yathkuroona
verses.translation: And when they are reminded, they remember not.

verses.text: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يَسۡتَسۡخِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waitha raaw ayatan yastaskhiroona
verses.translation: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.

verses.text: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Waqaloo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun
verses.translation: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.

verses.text: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona
verses.translation: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

verses.text: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Awaabaona alawwaloona
verses.translation: And our forefathers [as well]?"

verses.text: قُلۡ نَعَمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ دَٰخِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qul naAAam waantum dakhiroona
verses.translation: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

verses.text: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun faitha hum yanthuroona
verses.translation: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.

verses.text: وَقَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Waqaloo ya waylana hatha yawmu alddeeni
verses.translation: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."

verses.text: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Hatha yawmu alfasli allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
verses.translation: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

verses.text: ۞ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ohshuroo allatheena thalamoo waazwajahum wama kanoo yaAAbudoona
verses.translation: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds,[1289] and what they used to worship
verses.footnotes: [1289] Those similar to them in evil deeds. Another possible meaning is "their wives."

verses.text: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Min dooni Allahi faihdoohum ila sirati aljaheemi
verses.translation: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire

verses.text: وَقِفُوهُمۡۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسۡـُٔولُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waqifoohum innahum masooloona
verses.translation: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."

verses.text: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ma lakum la tanasaroona
verses.translation: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"

verses.text: بَلۡ هُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مُسۡتَسۡلِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Bal humu alyawma mustaslimoona
verses.translation: But they, that Day, are in surrender.

verses.text: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona
verses.translation: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.

verses.text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo innakum kuntum tatoonana AAani alyameeni
verses.translation: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."[1290]
verses.footnotes: [1290] i.e., from our position of strength, oppressing us. Or from where we would have grasped the truth, preventing us.

verses.text: قَالُواْ بَل لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo bal lam takoonoo mumineena
verses.translation: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

verses.text: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا طَٰغِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wama kana lana AAalaykum min sultanin bal kuntum qawman tagheena
verses.translation: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.

verses.text: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fahaqqa AAalayna qawlu rabbina inna lathaiqoona
verses.translation: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].

verses.text: فَأَغۡوَيۡنَٰكُمۡ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ
verses.transliteration: Faaghwaynakum inna kunna ghaweena
verses.translation: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."

verses.text: فَإِنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fainnahum yawmaithin fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona
verses.translation: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.

verses.text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna kathalika nafAAalu bialmujrimeena
verses.translation: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

verses.text: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innahum kanoo itha qeela lahum la ilaha illa Allahu yastakbiroona
verses.translation: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant

verses.text: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٖ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
verses.transliteration: Wayaqooloona ainna latarikoo alihatina lishaAAirin majnoonin
verses.translation: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"

verses.text: بَلۡ جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Bal jaa bialhaqqi wasaddaqa almursaleena
verses.translation: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.

verses.text: إِنَّكُمۡ لَذَآئِقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡأَلِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Innakum lathaiqoo alAAathabi alaleemi
verses.translation: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,

verses.text: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wama tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona
verses.translation: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -

verses.text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena
verses.translation: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

verses.text: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
verses.transliteration: Olaika lahum rizqun maAAloomun
verses.translation: Those will have a provision determined -

verses.text: فَوَٰكِهُ وَهُم مُّكۡرَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fawakihu wahum mukramoona
verses.translation: Fruits;[1291] and they will be honored
verses.footnotes: [1291] Meaning everything delicious.

verses.text: فِي جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Fee jannati alnnaAAeemi
verses.translation: In gardens of pleasure

verses.text: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: AAala sururin mutaqabileena
verses.translation: On thrones facing one another.

verses.text: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينِۭ
verses.transliteration: Yutafu AAalayhim bikasin min maAAeenin
verses.translation: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,

verses.text: بَيۡضَآءَ لَذَّةٖ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Baydaa laththatin lilshsharibeena
verses.translation: White and delicious to the drinkers;

verses.text: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
verses.transliteration: La feeha ghawlun wala hum AAanha yunzafoona
verses.translation: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.

verses.text: وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ عِينٞ
verses.transliteration: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi AAeenun
verses.translation: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances,[1292] with large, [beautiful] eyes,
verses.footnotes: [1292] i.e., chaste and modest, looking only at their mates.

verses.text: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيۡضٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ
verses.transliteration: Kaannahunna baydun maknoonun
verses.translation: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.

verses.text: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona
verses.translation: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

verses.text: قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٞ
verses.transliteration: Qala qailun minhum innee kana lee qareenun
verses.translation: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].

verses.text: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصَدِّقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Yaqoolu ainnaka lamina almusaddiqeena
verses.translation: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

verses.text: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
verses.transliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamadeenoona
verses.translation: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"

verses.text: قَالَ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qala hal antum muttaliAAoona
verses.translation: He will say,[1293] "Would you [care to] look?"
verses.footnotes: [1293] To his companions in Paradise.

verses.text: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: FaittalaAAa faraahu fee sawai aljaheemi
verses.translation: And he will look and see him[1294] in the midst of the Hellfire.
verses.footnotes: [1294] The companion who had tried to dissuade him from belief on earth.

verses.text: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرۡدِينِ
verses.transliteration: Qala taAllahi in kidta laturdeeni
verses.translation: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.

verses.text: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walawla niAAmatu rabbee lakuntu mina almuhdareena
verses.translation: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].

verses.text: أَفَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
verses.transliteration: Afama nahnu bimayyiteena
verses.translation: Then, are we not to die

verses.text: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illa mawtatana aloola wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena
verses.translation: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"

verses.text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Inna hatha lahuwa alfawzu alAAatheemu
verses.translation: Indeed, this is the great attainment.

verses.text: لِمِثۡلِ هَٰذَا فَلۡيَعۡمَلِ ٱلۡعَٰمِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Limithli hatha falyaAAmali alAAamiloona
verses.translation: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

verses.text: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.transliteration: Athalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu alzzaqqoomi
verses.translation: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?

verses.text: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهَا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna jaAAalnaha fitnatan lilththalimeena
verses.translation: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

verses.text: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٞ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Innaha shajaratun takhruju fee asli aljaheemi
verses.translation: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,

verses.text: طَلۡعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
verses.transliteration: TalAAuha kaannahu ruoosu alshshayateeni
verses.translation: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

verses.text: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fainnahum laakiloona minha famalioona minha albutoona
verses.translation: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.

verses.text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبٗا مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ
verses.transliteration: Thumma inna lahum AAalayha lashawban min hameemin
verses.translation: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.

verses.text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرۡجِعَهُمۡ لَإِلَى ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Thumma inna marjiAAahum laila aljaheemi
verses.translation: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.

verses.text: إِنَّهُمۡ أَلۡفَوۡاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ ضَآلِّينَ
verses.transliteration: Innahum alfaw abaahum dalleena
verses.translation: Indeed they found their fathers astray.

verses.text: فَهُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمۡ يُهۡرَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fahum AAala atharihim yuhraAAoona
verses.translation: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ ضَلَّ قَبۡلَهُمۡ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad dalla qablahum aktharu alawwaleena
verses.translation: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad arsalna feehim munthireena
verses.translation: And We had already sent among them warners.

verses.text: فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almunthareena
verses.translation: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -

verses.text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena
verses.translation: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٞ فَلَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمُجِيبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad nadana noohun falaniAAma almujeeboona
verses.translation: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.

verses.text: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Wanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi alAAatheemi
verses.translation: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.

verses.text: وَجَعَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ
verses.transliteration: WajaAAalna thurriyyatahu humu albaqeena
verses.translation: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

verses.text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena
verses.translation: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

verses.text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٖ فِي ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Salamun AAala noohin fee alAAalameena
verses.translation: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."

verses.text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena
verses.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena
verses.translation: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

verses.text: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma aghraqna alakhareena
verses.translation: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].

verses.text: ۞وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Wainna min sheeAAatihi laibraheema
verses.translation: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,

verses.text: إِذۡ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Ith jaa rabbahu biqalbin saleemin
verses.translation: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

verses.text: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi matha taAAbudoona
verses.translation: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?

verses.text: أَئِفۡكًا ءَالِهَةٗ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Aifkan alihatan doona Allahi tureedoona
verses.translation: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?

verses.text: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fama thannukum birabbi alAAalameena
verses.translation: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"

verses.text: فَنَظَرَ نَظۡرَةٗ فِي ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.transliteration: Fanathara nathratan fee alnnujoomi
verses.translation: And he cast a look at the stars

verses.text: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٞ
verses.transliteration: Faqala innee saqeemun
verses.translation: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."

verses.text: فَتَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ مُدۡبِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fatawallaw AAanhu mudbireena
verses.translation: So they turned away from him, departing.

verses.text: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faragha ila alihatihim faqala ala takuloona
verses.translation: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?[1295]
verses.footnotes: [1295] Consume the offerings placed before them.

verses.text: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ma lakum la tantiqoona
verses.translation: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"

verses.text: فَرَاغَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضَرۡبَۢا بِٱلۡيَمِينِ
verses.transliteration: Faragha AAalayhim darban bialyameeni
verses.translation: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.

verses.text: فَأَقۡبَلُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يَزِفُّونَ
verses.transliteration: Faaqbaloo ilayhi yaziffoona
verses.translation: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.

verses.text: قَالَ أَتَعۡبُدُونَ مَا تَنۡحِتُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qala ataAAbudoona ma tanhitoona
verses.translation: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,

verses.text: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: WaAllahu khalaqakum wama taAAmaloona
verses.translation: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"

verses.text: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنٗا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo ibnoo lahu bunyanan faalqoohu fee aljaheemi
verses.translation: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."

verses.text: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدٗا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Faaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alasfaleena
verses.translation: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.

verses.text: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
verses.transliteration: Waqala innee thahibun ila rabbee sayahdeeni
verses.translation: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.

verses.text: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee mina alssaliheena
verses.translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

verses.text: فَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٖ
verses.transliteration: Fabashsharnahu bighulamin haleemin
verses.translation: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

verses.text: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falamma balagha maAAahu alssaAAya qala ya bunayya innee ara fee almanami annee athbahuka faonthur matha tara qala ya abati ifAAal ma tumaru satajidunee in shaa Allahu mina alssabireena
verses.translation: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion,[1296] he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."
verses.footnotes: [1296] i.e., the ability to work and be of assistance.

verses.text: فَلَمَّآ أَسۡلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلۡجَبِينِ
verses.transliteration: Falamma aslama watallahu liljabeeni
verses.translation: And when they had both submitted[1297] and he put him down upon his forehead,
verses.footnotes: [1297] To the command of Allāh.

verses.text: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Wanadaynahu an ya ibraheemu
verses.translation: We called to him, "O Abraham,

verses.text: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qad saddaqta alrruya inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena
verses.translation: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

verses.text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡبَلَـٰٓؤُاْ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
verses.transliteration: Inna hatha lahuwa albalao almubeenu
verses.translation: Indeed, this was the clear trial.

verses.text: وَفَدَيۡنَٰهُ بِذِبۡحٍ عَظِيمٖ
verses.transliteration: Wafadaynahu bithibhin AAatheemin
verses.translation: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,[1298]
verses.footnotes: [1298] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) sent a huge ram to be sacrificed in place of Ishmael.

verses.text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena
verses.translation: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

verses.text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Salamun AAala ibraheema
verses.translation: "Peace upon Abraham."

verses.text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Kathalika najzee almuhsineena
verses.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena
verses.translation: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

verses.text: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيّٗا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wabashsharnahu biishaqa nabiyyan mina alssaliheena
verses.translation: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.[1299]
verses.footnotes: [1299] This verifies that the firstborn son who was to be sacrificed was Ishmael and not Isaac, as claimed by the Jews and Christians.

verses.text: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنٞ وَظَالِمٞ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينٞ
verses.transliteration: Wabarakna AAalayhi waAAala ishaqa wamin thurriyyatihima muhsinun wathalimun linafsihi mubeenun
verses.translation: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad mananna AAala moosa waharoona
verses.translation: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.

verses.text: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُمَا وَقَوۡمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Wanajjaynahuma waqawmahuma mina alkarbi alAAatheemi
verses.translation: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,

verses.text: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُمۡ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wanasarnahum fakanoo humu alghalibeena
verses.translation: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.

verses.text: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waataynahuma alkitaba almustabeena
verses.translation: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],

verses.text: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Wahadaynahuma alssirata almustaqeema
verses.translation: And We guided them on the straight path.

verses.text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Watarakna AAalayhima fee alakhireena
verses.translation: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:

verses.text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Salamun AAala moosa waharoona
verses.translation: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."

verses.text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena
verses.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

verses.text: إِنَّهُمَا مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innahuma min AAibadina almumineena
verses.translation: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ إِلۡيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wainna ilyasa lamina almursaleena
verses.translation: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,

verses.text: إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ith qala liqawmihi ala tattaqoona
verses.translation: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?

verses.text: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلٗا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: AtadAAoona baAAlan watatharoona ahsana alkhaliqeena
verses.translation: Do you call upon Baʿl[1300] and leave the best of creators -
verses.footnotes: [1300] The name of a great idol worshipped by the people and said to mean "lord."

verses.text: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Allaha rabbakum warabba abaikumu alawwaleena
verses.translation: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"

verses.text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fakaththaboohu fainnahum lamuhdaroona
verses.translation: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],

verses.text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena
verses.translation: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.

verses.text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena
verses.translation: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

verses.text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلۡ يَاسِينَ
verses.transliteration: Salamun AAala il yaseena
verses.translation: "Peace upon Elias."[1301]
verses.footnotes: [1301] Ilyāseen is said by some commentators to be a plural form, meaning "Elias and those who followed him."

verses.text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena
verses.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena
verses.translation: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ لُوطٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wainna lootan lamina almursaleena
verses.translation: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.

verses.text: إِذۡ نَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Ith najjaynahu waahlahu ajmaAAeena
verses.translation: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,

verses.text: إِلَّا عَجُوزٗا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illa AAajoozan fee alghabireena
verses.translation: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].

verses.text: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma dammarna alakhareena
verses.translation: Then We destroyed the others.

verses.text: وَإِنَّكُمۡ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيۡهِم مُّصۡبِحِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wainnakum latamurroona AAalayhim musbiheena
verses.translation: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning

verses.text: وَبِٱلَّيۡلِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wabiallayli afala taAAqiloona
verses.translation: And at night. Then will you not use reason?

verses.text: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wainna yoonusa lamina almursaleena
verses.translation: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.

verses.text: إِذۡ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
verses.transliteration: Ith abaqa ila alfulki almashhooni
verses.translation: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

verses.text: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُدۡحَضِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fasahama fakana mina almudhadeena
verses.translation: And he drew lots[1302] and was among the losers.
verses.footnotes: [1302] To determine who would be cast overboard in order to save the other passengers. Having been overloaded, the ship was on the verge of sinking.

verses.text: فَٱلۡتَقَمَهُ ٱلۡحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ
verses.transliteration: Failtaqamahu alhootu wahuwa muleemun
verses.translation: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.[1303]
verses.footnotes: [1303] For having given up hope on his people prematurely and having left them without permission from Allāh.
