verses.transliteration: Yawma yasmaAAoona alssayhata bialhaqqi thalika yawmu alkhurooji
verses.translation: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

verses.text: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Inna nahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wailayna almaseeru
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

verses.text: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيرٞ
verses.transliteration: Yawma tashaqqaqu alardu AAanhum siraAAan thalika hashrun AAalayna yaseerun
verses.translation: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.

verses.text: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِجَبَّارٖۖ فَذَكِّرۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona wama anta AAalayhim bijabbarin fathakkir bialqurani man yakhafu waAAeedi
verses.translation: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant.[1533] But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
verses.footnotes: [1533] Forcing people to belief or submission.

verses.text: وَٱلذَّـٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرۡوٗا
verses.transliteration: Waalththariyati tharwan
verses.translation: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]

verses.text: فَٱلۡحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقۡرٗا
verses.transliteration: Faalhamilati wiqran
verses.translation: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

verses.text: فَٱلۡجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسۡرٗا
verses.transliteration: Faaljariyati yusran
verses.translation: And the ships sailing with ease

verses.text: فَٱلۡمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمۡرًا
verses.transliteration: Faalmuqassimati amran
verses.translation: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

verses.text: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٞ
verses.transliteration: Innama tooAAadoona lasadiqun
verses.translation: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٞ
verses.transliteration: Wainna alddeena lawaqiAAun
verses.translation: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

verses.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡحُبُكِ
verses.transliteration: Waalssamai thati alhubuki
verses.translation: By the heaven containing pathways,[1535]
verses.footnotes: [1535] Explained as tracks, layers or orbits.

verses.text: إِنَّكُمۡ لَفِي قَوۡلٖ مُّخۡتَلِفٖ
verses.transliteration: Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalifin
verses.translation: Indeed, you are in differing speech.[1536]
verses.footnotes: [1536] About Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) and the Qur’ān.

verses.text: يُؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ أُفِكَ
verses.transliteration: Yufaku AAanhu man ofika
verses.translation: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.

verses.text: قُتِلَ ٱلۡخَرَّـٰصُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qutila alkharrasoona
verses.translation: Destroyed are the misinformers[1537]
verses.footnotes: [1537] Or "May they be destroyed" or "cursed."

verses.text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةٖ سَاهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoona
verses.translation: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

verses.text: يَسۡـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Yasaloona ayyana yawmu alddeeni
verses.translation: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

verses.text: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفۡتَنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma hum AAala alnnari yuftanoona
verses.translation: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

verses.text: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allathee kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona
verses.translation: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّـٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

verses.text: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena
verses.translation: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

verses.text: كَانُواْ قَلِيلٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahjaAAoona
verses.translation: They used to sleep but little of the night,[1538]
verses.footnotes: [1538] i.e., spending a portion of the night in prayer and supplication.

verses.text: وَبِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona
verses.translation: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

verses.text: وَفِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقّٞ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ
verses.transliteration: Wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi
verses.translation: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

verses.text: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّلۡمُوقِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena
verses.translation: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

verses.text: وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona
verses.translation: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

verses.text: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wafee alssamai rizqukum wama tooAAadoona
verses.translation: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

verses.text: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقّٞ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona
verses.translation: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

verses.text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena
verses.translation: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham?[1539] -
verses.footnotes: [1539] Who were angels given honored positions by Allāh.

verses.text: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗاۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona
verses.translation: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."

verses.text: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٖ سَمِينٖ
verses.transliteration: Faragha ila ahlihi fajaa biAAijlin sameenin
verses.translation: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.

verses.text: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona
verses.translation: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

verses.text: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةٗۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ
verses.transliteration: Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleemin
verses.translation: And he felt from them apprehension.[1540] They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
verses.footnotes: [1540] See footnote to 11:70.

verses.text: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةٖ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٞ
verses.transliteration: Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeemun
verses.translation: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

verses.text: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu
verses.translation: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

verses.text: ۞قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona
verses.translation: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

verses.text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena
verses.translation: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals[1541]
verses.footnotes: [1541] i.e., those who defied Lot (upon him be peace).

verses.text: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن طِينٖ
verses.transliteration: Linursila AAalayhim hijaratan min teenin
verses.translation: To send down upon them stones of clay,

verses.text: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeena
verses.translation: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

verses.text: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena
verses.translation: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.

verses.text: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fama wajadna feeha ghayra baytin mina almuslimeena
verses.translation: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.[1542]
verses.footnotes: [1542] i.e., Lot and his family, excepting his wife.

verses.text: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Watarakna feeha ayatan lillatheena yakhafoona alAAathaba alaleema
verses.translation: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

verses.text: وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
verses.transliteration: Wafee moosa ith arsalnahu ila firAAawna bisultanin mubeenin
verses.translation: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.[1543]
verses.footnotes: [1543] i.e., evidences.

verses.text: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٞ
verses.transliteration: Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun
verses.translation: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."

verses.text: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ
verses.transliteration: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleemun
verses.translation: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

verses.text: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Wafee AAadin ith arsalna AAalayhimu alrreeha alAAaqeema
verses.translation: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.[1544]
verses.footnotes: [1544] Barren of any benefit, i.e., evil.

verses.text: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Ma tatharu min shayin atat AAalayhi illa jaAAalathu kaalrrameemi
verses.translation: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

verses.text: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
verses.transliteration: Wafee thamooda ith qeela lahum tamattaAAoo hatta heenin
verses.translation: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

verses.text: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: FaAAataw AAan amri rabbihim faakhathathumu alssaAAiqatu wahum yanthuroona
verses.translation: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

verses.text: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامٖ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fama istataAAoo min qiyamin wama kanoo muntasireena
verses.translation: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

verses.text: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena
verses.translation: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

verses.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا بِأَيۡيْدٖ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona
verses.translation: And the heaven We constructed with strength,[1545] and indeed, We are [its] expander.
verses.footnotes: [1545] Literally, "hands."

verses.text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waalarda farashnaha faniAAma almahidoona
verses.translation: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

verses.text: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni laAAallakum tathakkaroona
verses.translation: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.

verses.text: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.transliteration: Fafirroo ila Allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun
verses.translation: So flee to Allāh.[1546] Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
verses.footnotes: [1546] i.e., turn to Allāh and take refuge in Him from disbelief and sin, thereby escaping His punishment.

verses.text: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.transliteration: Wala tajAAaloo maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun
verses.translation: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

verses.text: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ
verses.transliteration: Kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun
verses.translation: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

verses.text: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ
verses.transliteration: Atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona
verses.translation: Did they suggest it to them?[1547] Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
verses.footnotes: [1547] i.e., Did the former disbelievers pass on these words to the Makkans so that they repeat the same expressions?

verses.text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٖ
verses.transliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum fama anta bimaloomin
verses.translation: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.

verses.text: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfaAAu almumineena
verses.translation: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

verses.text: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liyaAAbudooni
verses.translation: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

verses.text: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقٖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ
verses.transliteration: Ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yutAAimooni
verses.translation: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ
verses.transliteration: Inna Allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu
verses.translation: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider,[1548] the firm possessor of strength.
verses.footnotes: [1548] Providing everything required by His creations during their decreed existence. His provision includes guidance.

verses.text: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبٗا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
verses.transliteration: Fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yastaAAjiloona
verses.translation: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.

verses.text: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona
verses.translation: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.

verses.text: وَٱلطُّورِ
verses.transliteration: Waalttoori
verses.translation: By the mount

verses.text: وَكِتَٰبٖ مَّسۡطُورٖ
verses.transliteration: Wakitabin mastoorin
verses.translation: And [by] a Book inscribed[1550]
verses.footnotes: [1550] Interpreted as the Preserved Slate or possibly the Qur’ān.

verses.text: فِي رَقّٖ مَّنشُورٖ
verses.transliteration: Fee raqqin manshoorin
verses.translation: In parchment spread open

verses.text: وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ
verses.transliteration: Waalbayti almaAAmoori
verses.translation: And [by] the frequented House[1551]
verses.footnotes: [1551] The house of worship for the angels in the seventh heaven, comparable to the Kaʿbah on earth.

verses.text: وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ
verses.transliteration: Waalssaqfi almarfooAAi
verses.translation: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high

verses.text: وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ
verses.transliteration: Waalbahri almasjoori
verses.translation: And [by] the sea set on fire,[1552]
verses.footnotes: [1552] On the Day of Resurrection. Or "the sea which has overflowed."

verses.text: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٞ
verses.transliteration: Inna AAathaba rabbika lawaqiAAun
verses.translation: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

verses.text: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٖ
verses.transliteration: Ma lahu min dafiAAin
verses.translation: Of it there is no preventer.

verses.text: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرٗا
verses.transliteration: Yawma tamooru alssamao mawran
verses.translation: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

verses.text: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرٗا
verses.transliteration: Wataseeru aljibalu sayran
verses.translation: And the mountains will pass on, departing[1553] -
verses.footnotes: [1553] Becoming dust and moving as clouds.

verses.text: فَوَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fawaylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
verses.translation: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

verses.text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Allatheena hum fee khawdin yalAAaboona
verses.translation: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

verses.text: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verses.transliteration: Yawma yudaAAAAoona ila nari jahannama daAAAAan
verses.translation: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

verses.text: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Hathihi alnnaru allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona
verses.translation: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

verses.text: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Afasihrun hatha am antum la tubsiroona
verses.translation: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

verses.text: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Islawha faisbiroo aw la tasbiroo sawaon AAalaykum innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona
verses.translation: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّـٰتٖ وَنَعِيمٖ
verses.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaAAeemin
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

verses.text: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Fakiheena bima atahum rabbuhum wawaqahum rabbuhum AAathaba aljaheemi
verses.translation: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

verses.text: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona
verses.translation: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

verses.text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّصۡفُوفَةٖۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ
verses.transliteration: Muttakieena AAala sururin masfoofatin wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin
verses.translation: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٞ
verses.transliteration: Waallatheena amanoo waittabaAAathum thurriyyatuhum bieemanin alhaqna bihim thurriyyatahum wama alatnahum min AAamalihim min shayin kullu imriin bima kasaba raheenun
verses.translation: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.[1554] Every person, for what he earned, is retained.[1555]
verses.footnotes:
[1554] i.e., the reward thereof.
[1555] i.e., subject or held responsible. Literally, "a hostage."

verses.text: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٖ وَلَحۡمٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waamdadnahum bifakihatin walahmin mimma yashtahoona
verses.translation: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

verses.text: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا لَّا لَغۡوٞ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمٞ
verses.transliteration: YatanazaAAoona feeha kasan la laghwun feeha wala tatheemun
verses.translation: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

verses.text: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٞ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ
verses.transliteration: Wayatoofu AAalayhim ghilmanun lahum kaannahum luluon maknoonun
verses.translation: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

verses.text: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona
verses.translation: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

verses.text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo inna kunna qablu fee ahlina mushfiqeena
verses.translation: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].

verses.text: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.transliteration: Famanna Allahu AAalayna wawaqana AAathaba alssamoomi
verses.translation: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

verses.text: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Inna kunna min qablu nadAAoohu innahu huwa albarru alrraheemu
verses.translation: Indeed, we used to supplicate[1556] Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
verses.footnotes: [1556] i.e., worship.

verses.text: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٖ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
verses.transliteration: Fathakkir fama anta biniAAmati rabbika bikahin wala majnoonin
verses.translation: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

verses.text: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٞ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
verses.transliteration: Am yaqooloona shaAAirun natarabbasu bihi rayba almanooni
verses.translation: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?[1557]
verses.footnotes: [1557] i.e., some accident or inevitable death.

verses.text: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qul tarabbasoo fainnee maAAakum mina almutarabbiseena
verses.translation: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

verses.text: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am tamuruhum ahlamuhum bihatha am hum qawmun taghoona
verses.translation: Or do their minds[1558] command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
verses.footnotes: [1558] In this expression is also a subtle allusion to the leaders of the Quraysh, who considered themselves to be great minds.

verses.text: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am yaqooloona taqawwalahu bal la yuminoona
verses.translation: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

verses.text: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falyatoo bihadeethin mithlihi in kanoo sadiqeena
verses.translation: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

verses.text: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am khuliqoo min ghayri shayin am humu alkhaliqoona
verses.translation: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

verses.text: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am khalaqoo alssamawati waalarda bal la yooqinoona
verses.translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

verses.text: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am AAindahum khazainu rabbika am humu almusaytiroona
verses.translation: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

verses.text: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمٞ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Am lahum sullamun yastamiAAoona feehi falyati mustamiAAuhum bisultanin mubeenin
verses.translation: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].

verses.text: أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am lahu albanatu walakumu albanoona
verses.translation: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

verses.text: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona
verses.translation: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

verses.text: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona
verses.translation: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

verses.text: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗاۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am yureedoona kaydan faallatheena kafaroo humu almakeedoona
verses.translation: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

verses.text: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am lahum ilahun ghayru Allahi subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona
verses.translation: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

verses.text: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطٗا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابٞ مَّرۡكُومٞ
verses.transliteration: Wain yaraw kisfan mina alssamai saqitan yaqooloo sahabun markoomun
verses.translation: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling,[1559] they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
verses.footnotes: [1559] Marking the onset of Allāh's punishment, as they had requested.

verses.text: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fatharhum hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee feehi yusAAaqoona
verses.translation: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

verses.text: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma la yughnee AAanhum kayduhum shayan wala hum yunsaroona
verses.translation: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابٗا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wainna lillatheena thalamoo AAathaban doona thalika walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona
verses.translation: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment[1560] before that, but most of them do not know.
verses.footnotes: [1560] If not in this world, in the grave.

verses.text: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.transliteration: Waisbir lihukmi rabbika fainnaka biaAAyunina wasabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoomu
verses.translation: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise

verses.text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.transliteration: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waidbara alnnujoomi
verses.translation: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.

verses.text: وَٱلنَّجۡمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waalnnajmi itha hawa
verses.translation: By the star when it descends,

verses.text: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمۡ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Ma dalla sahibukum wama ghawa
verses.translation: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,

verses.text: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Wama yantiqu AAani alhawa
verses.translation: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

verses.text: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحۡيٞ يُوحَىٰ
verses.transliteration: In huwa illa wahyun yooha
verses.translation: It is not but a revelation revealed,

verses.text: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡقُوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: AAallamahu shadeedu alquwa
verses.translation: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -

verses.text: ذُو مِرَّةٖ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Thoo mirratin faistawa
verses.translation: One of soundness.[1562] And he rose to [his] true form[1563]
verses.footnotes:
[1562] i.e., strength of body and of mind.
[1563] Gabriel appeared to Muḥammad (ﷺ) at the outset of his prophethood in the angelic form in which Allāh originally created him.

verses.text: وَهُوَ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa bialofuqi alaAAla
verses.translation: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.[1564]
verses.footnotes: [1564] i.e., in the sky, above the eastern horizon.

verses.text: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Thumma dana fatadalla
verses.translation: Then he approached and descended

verses.text: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوۡسَيۡنِ أَوۡ أَدۡنَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fakana qaba qawsayni aw adna
verses.translation: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

verses.text: فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ مَآ أَوۡحَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Faawha ila AAabdihi ma awha
verses.translation: And he revealed to His Servant[1565] what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].
verses.footnotes: [1565] i.e., to the Servant of Allāh, Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).

verses.text: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلۡفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Ma kathaba alfuadu ma raa
verses.translation: The heart[1566] did not lie [about] what it saw.
verses.footnotes: [1566] i.e., mind or perception (of the Prophet [ﷺ]).

verses.text: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Afatumaroonahu AAala ma yara
verses.translation: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ نَزۡلَةً أُخۡرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad raahu nazlatan okhra
verses.translation: And he certainly saw him in another descent[1567]
verses.footnotes: [1567] i.e., on another occasion. During his ascent into the heavens (al-Miʿrāj), the Prophet (ﷺ) also saw Gabriel in his true form.

verses.text: عِندَ سِدۡرَةِ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ
verses.transliteration: AAinda sidrati almuntaha
verses.translation: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -

verses.text: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: AAindaha jannatu almawa
verses.translation: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -

verses.text: إِذۡ يَغۡشَى ٱلسِّدۡرَةَ مَا يَغۡشَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Ith yaghsha alssidrata ma yaghsha
verses.translation: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].[1568]
verses.footnotes: [1568] Then and there he (ﷺ) saw Gabriel in angelic form.

verses.text: مَا زَاغَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Ma zagha albasaru wama tagha
verses.translation: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

verses.text: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Laqad raa min ayati rabbihi alkubra
verses.translation: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.

verses.text: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلۡعُزَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Afaraaytumu allata waalAAuzza
verses.translation: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?

verses.text: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Wamanata alththalithata alokhra
verses.translation: And Manāt, the third - the other one?[1569]
verses.footnotes: [1569] The three names given in this and the previous verse are those of well-known "goddesses" which were worshipped by the pagan Arabs before the spread of Islām.

verses.text: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Alakumu alththakaru walahu alontha
verses.translation: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

verses.text: تِلۡكَ إِذٗا قِسۡمَةٞ ضِيزَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Tilka ithan qismatun deeza
verses.translation: That, then, is an unjust division.[1570]
verses.footnotes: [1570] According to their own standards.

verses.text: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءٞ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: In hiya illa asmaon sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultanin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wama tahwa alanfusu walaqad jaahum min rabbihimu alhuda
verses.translation: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.

verses.text: أَمۡ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Am lilinsani ma tamanna
verses.translation: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?

verses.text: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Falillahi alakhiratu waaloola
verses.translation: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

verses.text: ۞وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Wakam min malakin fee alssamawati la tughnee shafaAAatuhum shayan illa min baAAdi an yathana Allahu liman yashao wayarda
verses.translation: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati layusammoona almalaikata tasmiyata alontha
verses.translation: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

verses.text: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـٔٗا
verses.transliteration: Wama lahum bihi min AAilmin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wainna alththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan
verses.translation: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.

verses.text: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
verses.transliteration: FaaAArid AAan man tawalla AAan thikrina walam yurid illa alhayata alddunya
verses.translation: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.

verses.text: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Thalika mablaghuhum mina alAAilmi inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bimani ihtada
verses.translation: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.

verses.text: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى
verses.transliteration: Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi liyajziya allatheena asaoo bima AAamiloo wayajziya allatheena ahsanoo bialhusna
verses.translation: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -

verses.text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةٞ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Allatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha illa allamama inna rabbaka wasiAAu almaghfirati huwa aAAlamu bikum ith anshaakum mina alardi waith antum ajinnatun fee butooni ommahatikum fala tuzakkoo anfusakum huwa aAAlamu bimani ittaqa
verses.translation: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.

verses.text: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Afaraayta allathee tawalla
verses.translation: Have you seen the one who turned away

verses.text: وَأَعۡطَىٰ قَلِيلٗا وَأَكۡدَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: WaaAAta qaleelan waakda
verses.translation: And gave a little and [then] refrained?

verses.text: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: aAAindahu AAilmu alghaybi fahuwa yara
verses.translation: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?[1571]
verses.footnotes: [1571] Knows that his provision will be exhausted if he spends on the poor, while Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) has promised otherwise.

verses.text: أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Am lam yunabba bima fee suhufi moosa
verses.translation: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

verses.text: وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِي وَفَّىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Waibraheema allathee waffa
verses.translation: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -

verses.text: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Alla taziru waziratun wizra okhra
verses.translation: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

verses.text: وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waan laysa lilinsani illa ma saAAa
verses.translation: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

verses.text: وَأَنَّ سَعۡيَهُۥ سَوۡفَ يُرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waanna saAAyahu sawfa yura
verses.translation: And that his effort is going to be seen -

verses.text: ثُمَّ يُجۡزَىٰهُ ٱلۡجَزَآءَ ٱلۡأَوۡفَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Thumma yujzahu aljazaa alawfa
verses.translation: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -

verses.text: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waanna ila rabbika almuntaha
verses.translation: And that to your Lord is the finality

verses.text: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضۡحَكَ وَأَبۡكَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waannahu huwa adhaka waabka
verses.translation: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

verses.text: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحۡيَا
verses.transliteration: Waannahu huwa amata waahya
verses.translation: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

verses.text: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waannahu khalaqa alzzawjayni alththakara waalontha
verses.translation: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -

verses.text: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ إِذَا تُمۡنَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Min nutfatin itha tumna
verses.translation: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

verses.text: وَأَنَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waanna AAalayhi alnnashata alokhra
verses.translation: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.

verses.text: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغۡنَىٰ وَأَقۡنَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waannahu huwa aghna waaqna
verses.translation: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

verses.text: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعۡرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waannahu huwa rabbu alshshiAAra
verses.translation: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius[1572]
verses.footnotes: [1572] A star worshipped by some of the pagan Arabs.

verses.text: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهۡلَكَ عَادًا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waannahu ahlaka AAadan aloola
verses.translation: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad

verses.text: وَثَمُودَاْ فَمَآ أَبۡقَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wathamooda fama abqa
verses.translation: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -

verses.text: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo hum athlama waatgha
verses.translation: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

verses.text: وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَةَ أَهۡوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waalmutafikata ahwa
verses.translation: And the overturned towns[1573] He hurled down
verses.footnotes: [1573] Whose inhabitants defied Prophet Lot.

verses.text: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Faghashshaha ma ghashsha
verses.translation: And covered them by that which He covered.[1574]
verses.footnotes: [1574] i.e., a rain of stones.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbika tatamara
verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

verses.text: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٞ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Hatha natheerun mina alnnuthuri aloola
verses.translation: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.

verses.text: أَزِفَتِ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةُ
verses.transliteration: Azifati alazifatu
verses.translation: The Approaching Day has approached.

verses.text: لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
verses.transliteration: Laysa laha min dooni Allahi kashifatun
verses.translation: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.

verses.text: أَفَمِنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ تَعۡجَبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Afamin hatha alhadeethi taAAjaboona
verses.translation: Then at this statement do you wonder?

verses.text: وَتَضۡحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبۡكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Watadhakoona wala tabkoona
verses.translation: And you laugh and do not weep

verses.text: وَأَنتُمۡ سَٰمِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waantum samidoona
verses.translation: While you are proudly sporting?[1575]
verses.footnotes: [1575] Additional meanings are "singing [with expanded chest]," "heedless," or "lost in vain amusements."

verses.text: فَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِۤ وَٱعۡبُدُواْ۩
verses.transliteration: Faosjudoo lillahi waoAAbudoo
verses.translation: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].

verses.text: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
verses.transliteration: Iqtarabati alssaAAatu wainshaqqa alqamaru
verses.translation: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].[1577]
verses.footnotes: [1577] This was a sign given by Allāh to Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) when the Quraysh challenged him to show them a miracle.

verses.text: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرٞ مُّسۡتَمِرّٞ
verses.transliteration: Wain yaraw ayatan yuAAridoo wayaqooloo sihrun mustamirrun
verses.translation: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."[1578]
verses.footnotes: [1578] Or "Continuing magic."

verses.text: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرٖ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
verses.transliteration: Wakaththaboo waittabaAAoo ahwaahum wakullu amrin mustaqirrun
verses.translation: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad jaahum mina alanbai ma feehi muzdajarun
verses.translation: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.

verses.text: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةٞۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.transliteration: Hikmatun balighatun fama tughnee alnnuthuru
verses.translation: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

verses.text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ نُّكُرٍ
verses.transliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum yawma yadAAu alddaAAi ila shayin nukurin
verses.translation: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller[1579] calls to something forbidding,
verses.footnotes: [1579] Said to be an angel announcing the account and judgement.

verses.text: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٞ مُّنتَشِرٞ
verses.transliteration: KhushshaAAan absaruhum yakhrujoona mina alajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashirun
verses.translation: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

verses.text: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرٞ
verses.transliteration: MuhtiAAeena ila alddaAAi yaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun AAasirun
verses.translation: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

verses.text: ۞كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونٞ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ
verses.transliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakaththaboo AAabdana waqaloo majnoonun waizdujira
verses.translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

verses.text: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبٞ فَٱنتَصِرۡ
verses.transliteration: FadaAAa rabbahu annee maghloobun faintasir
verses.translation: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

verses.text: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٖ مُّنۡهَمِرٖ
verses.transliteration: Fafatahna abwaba alssamai bimain munhamirin
verses.translation: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

verses.text: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونٗا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرٖ قَدۡ قُدِرَ
verses.transliteration: Wafajjarna alarda AAuyoonan failtaqa almao AAala amrin qad qudira
verses.translation: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

verses.text: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحٖ وَدُسُرٖ
verses.transliteration: Wahamalnahu AAala thati alwahin wadusurin
verses.translation: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

verses.text: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءٗ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.transliteration: Tajree biaAAyunina jazaan liman kana kufira
verses.translation: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

verses.text: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad taraknaha ayatan fahal min muddakirin
verses.translation: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

verses.text: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
verses.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.[1580]
verses.footnotes: [1580] To those after them, who were expected to derive a lesson from previous occurrences.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.text: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Kaththabat AAadun fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
verses.translation: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.text: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا صَرۡصَرٗا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٖ مُّسۡتَمِرّٖ
verses.transliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirrin
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

verses.text: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٖ مُّنقَعِرٖ
verses.transliteration: TanziAAu alnnasa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin munqaAAirin
verses.translation: Extracting the people[1581] as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
verses.footnotes: [1581] From their hiding places.

verses.text: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
verses.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.text: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Kaththabat thamoodu bialnnuthuri
verses.translation: Thamūd denied the warning.

verses.text: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٗا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدٗا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.transliteration: Faqaloo abasharan minna wahidan nattabiAAuhu inna ithan lafee dalalin wasuAAurin
verses.translation: And said, "Is it one human being[1582] among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
verses.footnotes: [1582] i.e., the prophet Ṣāliḥ.

verses.text: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٞ
verses.transliteration: Aolqiya alththikru AAalayhi min baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashirun
verses.translation: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

verses.text: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدٗا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ
verses.transliteration: SayaAAlamoona ghadan mani alkaththabu alashiru
verses.translation: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

verses.text: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةٗ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ
verses.transliteration: Inna mursiloo alnnaqati fitnatan lahum fairtaqibhum waistabir
verses.translation: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.[1583]
verses.footnotes: [1583] This and the following verse are an address to Ṣāliḥ (upon him be peace).

verses.text: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبٖ مُّحۡتَضَرٞ
verses.transliteration: Wanabbihum anna almaa qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadarun
verses.translation: And inform them that the water is shared between them,[1584] each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
verses.footnotes: [1584] i.e., between the tribe of Thamūd and the she-camel - a day for each to drink.

verses.text: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.transliteration: Fanadaw sahibahum fataAAata faAAaqara
verses.translation: But they called their companion,[1585] and he dared[1586] and hamstrung [her].
verses.footnotes:
[1585] i.e., the worst and most despicable among them.
[1586] Or "he took," referring to his sword or to the she-camel.

verses.text: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
verses.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.text: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
verses.transliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathiri
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.text: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Kaththabat qawmu lootin bialnnuthuri
verses.translation: The people of Lot denied the warning.

verses.text: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٖۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٖ
verses.transliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim hasiban illa ala lootin najjaynahum bisaharin
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.

verses.text: نِّعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ
verses.transliteration: NiAAmatan min AAindina kathalika najzee man shakara
verses.translation: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad antharahum batshatana fatamaraw bialnnuthuri
verses.translation: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad rawadoohu AAan dayfihi fatamasna aAAyunahum fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri
verses.translation: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٞ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad sabbahahum bukratan AAathabun mustaqirrun
verses.translation: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

verses.text: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri
verses.translation: So taste My punishment and warning.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad jaa ala firAAawna alnnuthuru
verses.translation: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

verses.text: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزٖ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
verses.transliteration: Kaththaboo biayatina kulliha faakhathnahum akhtha AAazeezin muqtadirin
verses.translation: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

verses.text: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٞ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.transliteration: Akuffarukum khayrun min olaikum am lakum baraatun fee alzzuburi
verses.translation: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?

verses.text: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعٞ مُّنتَصِرٞ
verses.transliteration: Am yaqooloona nahnu jameeAAun muntasirun
verses.translation: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

verses.text: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.transliteration: Sayuhzamu aljamAAu wayuwalloona alddubura
verses.translation: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].[1587]
verses.footnotes: [1587] This foretold event took place on the day of Badr.

verses.text: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.transliteration: Bali alssaAAatu mawAAiduhum waalssaAAatu adha waamarru
verses.translation: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٖ
verses.transliteration: Inna almujrimeena fee dalalin wasuAAurin
verses.translation: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.[1588].
verses.footnotes: [1588] Or "in blazing fires."

verses.text: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma yushaboona fee alnnari AAala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqara
verses.translation: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."[1589]
verses.footnotes: [1589] One of the proper names of Hell.

verses.text: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٖ
verses.transliteration: Inna kulla shayin khalaqnahu biqadarin
verses.translation: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٞ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
verses.transliteration: Wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bialbasari
verses.translation: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad ahlakna ashyaAAakum fahal min muddakirin
verses.translation: And We have already destroyed your kinds,[1590] so is there any who will remember?
verses.footnotes: [1590] i.e., those similar to you in attitude and behavior when they rejected Allāh's messengers.

verses.text: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٖ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.transliteration: Wakullu shayin faAAaloohu fee alzzuburi
verses.translation: And everything they did is in written records.

verses.text: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٖ وَكَبِيرٖ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
verses.transliteration: Wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatarun
verses.translation: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّـٰتٖ وَنَهَرٖ
verses.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaharin
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

verses.text: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
verses.transliteration: Fee maqAAadi sidqin AAinda maleekin muqtadirin
verses.translation: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.[1591]
verses.footnotes: [1591] Who accomplishes whatever He wills whenever He wills.

verses.text: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ
verses.transliteration: Alrrahmanu
verses.translation: The Most Merciful

verses.text: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ
verses.transliteration: AAallama alqurana
verses.translation: Taught the Qur’ān,

verses.text: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ
verses.transliteration: Khalaqa alinsana
verses.translation: Created man,

verses.text: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلۡبَيَانَ
verses.transliteration: AAallamahu albayana
verses.translation: [And] taught him eloquence.

verses.text: ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ بِحُسۡبَانٖ
verses.transliteration: Alshshamsu waalqamaru bihusbanin
verses.translation: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

verses.text: وَٱلنَّجۡمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسۡجُدَانِ
verses.transliteration: Waalnnajmu waalshshajaru yasjudani
verses.translation: And the stars and trees prostrate.[1593]
verses.footnotes: [1593] They submit obediently to the laws of Allāh. See 22:18. An additional meaning of "najm" is vegetation of a kind without a trunk, stalk or stem.

verses.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
verses.transliteration: Waalssamaa rafaAAaha wawadaAAa almeezana
verses.translation: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

verses.text: أَلَّا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡمِيزَانِ
verses.transliteration: Alla tatghaw fee almeezani
verses.translation: That you not transgress within the balance.

verses.text: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
verses.transliteration: Waaqeemoo alwazna bialqisti wala tukhsiroo almeezana
verses.translation: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

verses.text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلۡأَنَامِ
verses.transliteration: Waalarda wadaAAaha lilanami
verses.translation: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

verses.text: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَٱلنَّخۡلُ ذَاتُ ٱلۡأَكۡمَامِ
verses.transliteration: Feeha fakihatun waalnnakhlu thatu alakmami
verses.translation: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

verses.text: وَٱلۡحَبُّ ذُو ٱلۡعَصۡفِ وَٱلرَّيۡحَانُ
verses.transliteration: Waalhabbu thoo alAAasfi waalrrayhani
verses.translation: And grain having husks and scented plants.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?[1594]
verses.footnotes: [1594] Literally, "you two," addressing the species of mankind and jinn.

verses.text: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ كَٱلۡفَخَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Khalaqa alinsana min salsalin kaalfakhkhari
verses.translation: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

verses.text: وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٖ مِّن نَّارٖ
verses.transliteration: Wakhalaqa aljanna min marijin min narin
verses.translation: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ
verses.transliteration: Rabbu almashriqayni warabbu almaghribayni
verses.translation: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.[1595]
verses.footnotes: [1595] i.e., the points of sunrise in the east and sunset in the west in both summer and winter.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ يَلۡتَقِيَانِ
verses.transliteration: Maraja albahrayni yaltaqiyani
verses.translation: He released the two seas,[1596] meeting [one another];
verses.footnotes: [1596] Two bodies of water or two sea waters of distinct characteristics.

verses.text: بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٞ لَّا يَبۡغِيَانِ
verses.transliteration: Baynahuma barzakhun la yabghiyani
verses.translation: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُمَا ٱللُّؤۡلُؤُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ
verses.transliteration: Yakhruju minhuma alluluo waalmarjanu
verses.translation: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: وَلَهُ ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ
verses.transliteration: Walahu aljawari almunshaatu fee albahri kaalaAAlami
verses.translation: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: كُلُّ مَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا فَانٖ
verses.transliteration: Kullu man AAalayha fanin
verses.translation: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,

verses.text: وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
verses.transliteration: Wayabqa wajhu rabbika thoo aljalali waalikrami
verses.translation: And there will remain the Face[1597] of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
verses.footnotes: [1597] See footnote to 2:19.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنٖ
verses.transliteration: Yasaluhu man fee alssamawati waalardi kulla yawmin huwa fee shanin
verses.translation: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.[1598]
verses.footnotes: [1598] For each of His creatures.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: سَنَفۡرُغُ لَكُمۡ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
verses.transliteration: Sanafrughu lakum ayyuha alththaqalani
verses.translation: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.[1599]
verses.footnotes: [1599] Specifically two: mankind and jinn.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ
verses.transliteration: Ya maAAshara aljinni waalinsi ini istataAAtum an tanfuthoo min aqtari alssamawati waalardi faonfuthoo la tanfuthoona illa bisultanin
verses.translation: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظٞ مِّن نَّارٖ وَنُحَاسٞ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
verses.transliteration: Yursalu AAalaykuma shuwathun min narin wanuhasun fala tantasirani
verses.translation: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke,[1600] and you will not defend yourselves.
verses.footnotes: [1600] Another possible meaning is liquefied brass or copper.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ وَرۡدَةٗ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
verses.transliteration: Faitha inshaqqati alssamao fakanat wardatan kaalddihani
verses.translation: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil[1601] -
verses.footnotes: [1601] Or "like a tanned skin."

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

verses.text: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٞ وَلَا جَآنّٞ
verses.transliteration: Fayawmaithin la yusalu AAan thanbihi insun wala jannun
verses.translation: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.[1602]
verses.footnotes: [1602] Once they have been condemned to the Fire.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: يُعۡرَفُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمۡ فَيُؤۡخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِي وَٱلۡأَقۡدَامِ
verses.transliteration: YuAArafu almujrimoona biseemahum fayukhathu bialnnawasee waalaqdami
verses.translation: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Hathihi jahannamu allatee yukaththibu biha almujrimoona
verses.translation: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.

verses.text: يَطُوفُونَ بَيۡنَهَا وَبَيۡنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٖ
verses.transliteration: Yatoofoona baynaha wabayna hameemin anin
verses.translation: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: وَلِمَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ
verses.transliteration: Waliman khafa maqama rabbihi jannatani
verses.translation: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord[1603] are two gardens -
verses.footnotes: [1603] An alternative meaning is "the standing [for account] before his Lord."

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

verses.text: ذَوَاتَآ أَفۡنَانٖ
verses.transliteration: Thawata afnanin
verses.translation: Having [spreading] branches.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ تَجۡرِيَانِ
verses.transliteration: Feehima AAaynani tajriyani
verses.translation: In both of them are two springs, flowing.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٖ زَوۡجَانِ
verses.transliteration: Feehima min kulli fakihatin zawjani
verses.translation: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشِۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنۡ إِسۡتَبۡرَقٖۚ وَجَنَى ٱلۡجَنَّتَيۡنِ دَانٖ
verses.transliteration: Muttakieena AAala furushin batainuha min istabraqin wajana aljannatayni danin
verses.translation: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسٞ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنّٞ
verses.transliteration: Feehinna qasiratu alttarfi lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun
verses.translation: In them are women limiting [their] glances,[1604] untouched[1605] before them by man or jinnī -
verses.footnotes:
[1604] To their own mates, i.e., being chaste and modest.
[1605] Literally, they have not been caused to bleed by loss of virginity.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

verses.text: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلۡيَاقُوتُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ
verses.transliteration: Kaannahunna alyaqootu waalmarjanu
verses.translation: As if they were rubies and coral.[1606]
verses.footnotes: [1606] In purity, color and beauty.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: هَلۡ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنُ
verses.transliteration: Hal jazao alihsani illa alihsanu
verses.translation: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
verses.transliteration: Wamin doonihima jannatani
verses.translation: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

verses.text: مُدۡهَآمَّتَانِ
verses.transliteration: Mudhammatani
verses.translation: Dark green [in color].

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
verses.transliteration: Feehima AAaynani naddakhatani
verses.translation: In both of them are two springs, spouting.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَنَخۡلٞ وَرُمَّانٞ
verses.transliteration: Feehima fakihatun wanakhlun warummanun
verses.translation: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: فِيهِنَّ خَيۡرَٰتٌ حِسَانٞ
verses.transliteration: Feehinna khayratun hisanun
verses.translation: In them are good and beautiful women -

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

verses.text: حُورٞ مَّقۡصُورَٰتٞ فِي ٱلۡخِيَامِ
verses.transliteration: Hoorun maqsooratun fee alkhiyami
verses.translation: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

verses.text: لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسٞ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنّٞ
verses.transliteration: Lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun
verses.translation: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

verses.text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفۡرَفٍ خُضۡرٖ وَعَبۡقَرِيٍّ حِسَانٖ
verses.transliteration: Muttakieena AAala rafrafin khudrin waAAabqariyyin hisanin
verses.translation: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
verses.transliteration: Tabaraka ismu rabbika thee aljalali waalikrami
verses.translation: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

verses.text: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلۡوَاقِعَةُ
verses.transliteration: Itha waqaAAati alwaqiAAatu
verses.translation: When the Occurrence occurs,

verses.text: لَيۡسَ لِوَقۡعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
verses.transliteration: Laysa liwaqAAatiha kathibatun
verses.translation: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

verses.text: خَافِضَةٞ رَّافِعَةٌ
verses.transliteration: Khafidatun rafiAAatun
verses.translation: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].[1608]
verses.footnotes: [1608] According to their deeds rather than wealth and social position, as is the case in this world.

verses.text: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ رَجّٗا
verses.transliteration: Itha rujjati alardu rajjan
verses.translation: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

verses.text: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ بَسّٗا
verses.transliteration: Wabussati aljibalu bassan
verses.translation: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

verses.text: فَكَانَتۡ هَبَآءٗ مُّنۢبَثّٗا
verses.transliteration: Fakanat habaan munbaththan
verses.translation: And become dust dispersing,

verses.text: وَكُنتُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا ثَلَٰثَةٗ
verses.transliteration: Wakuntum azwajan thalathatan
verses.translation: And you become [of] three kinds:

verses.text: فَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ
verses.transliteration: Faashabu almaymanati ma ashabu almaymanati
verses.translation: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?[1609]
verses.footnotes: [1609] i.e., those given their records in their right hand and who are destined for Paradise.

verses.text: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
verses.transliteration: Waashabu almashamati ma ashabu almashamati
verses.translation: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?[1610]
verses.footnotes: [1610] i.e., those given their records in their left hand and who are destined for Hell.

verses.text: وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waalssabiqoona alssabiqoona
verses.translation: And the forerunners, the forerunners[1611] -
verses.footnotes: [1611] The words can also be understood as a complete sentence, i.e., "The forerunners [in good deeds] are the forerunners [in entering Paradise]."

verses.text: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Olaika almuqarraboona
verses.translation: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]

verses.text: فِي جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Fee jannati alnnaAAeemi
verses.translation: In the Gardens of Pleasure,

verses.text: ثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Thullatun mina alawwaleena
verses.translation: A [large] company of the former peoples

verses.text: وَقَلِيلٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waqaleelun mina alakhireena
verses.translation: And a few of the later peoples,

verses.text: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّوۡضُونَةٖ
verses.transliteration: AAala sururin mawdoonatin
verses.translation: On thrones woven [with ornament],

verses.text: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيۡهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Muttakieena AAalayha mutaqabileena
verses.translation: Reclining on them, facing each other.

verses.text: يَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona
verses.translation: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal

verses.text: بِأَكۡوَابٖ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينٖ
verses.transliteration: Biakwabin waabareeqa wakasin min maAAeenin
verses.translation: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

verses.text: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنۡهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
verses.transliteration: La yusaddaAAoona AAanha wala yunzifoona
verses.translation: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

verses.text: وَفَٰكِهَةٖ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wafakihatin mimma yatakhayyaroona
verses.translation: And fruit of what they select

verses.text: وَلَحۡمِ طَيۡرٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walahmi tayrin mimma yashtahoona
verses.translation: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

verses.text: وَحُورٌ عِينٞ
verses.transliteration: Wahoorun AAeenun
verses.translation: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,

verses.text: كَأَمۡثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤۡلُوِٕ ٱلۡمَكۡنُونِ
verses.transliteration: Kaamthali allului almaknooni
verses.translation: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,

verses.text: جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona
verses.translation: As reward for what they used to do.

verses.text: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمًا
verses.transliteration: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala tatheeman
