verses.transliteration: Labitheena feeha ahqaban
verses.translation: In which they will remain for ages [unending].

verses.text: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدٗا وَلَا شَرَابًا
verses.transliteration: La yathooqoona feeha bardan wala sharaban
verses.translation: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.

verses.text: إِلَّا حَمِيمٗا وَغَسَّاقٗا
verses.transliteration: Illa hameeman waghassaqan
verses.translation: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -

verses.text: جَزَآءٗ وِفَاقًا
verses.transliteration: Jazaan wifaqan
verses.translation: An appropriate recompense.[1824]
verses.footnotes: [1824] In proportion to and comparable with their crimes.

verses.text: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابٗا
verses.transliteration: Innahum kanoo la yarjoona hisaban
verses.translation: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

verses.text: وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابٗا
verses.transliteration: Wakaththaboo biayatina kiththaban
verses.translation: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

verses.text: وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ كِتَٰبٗا
verses.transliteration: Wakulla shayin ahsaynahu kitaban
verses.translation: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

verses.text: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمۡ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
verses.transliteration: Fathooqoo falan nazeedakum illa AAathaban
verses.translation: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."[1825]
verses.footnotes: [1825] This announcement will be made to the companions of Hell.

verses.text: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
verses.transliteration: Inna lilmuttaqeena mafazan
verses.translation: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment[1826] -
verses.footnotes: [1826] Of security, success and reward, including escape and safety from Hell.

verses.text: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعۡنَٰبٗا
verses.transliteration: Hadaiqa waaAAnaban
verses.translation: Gardens and grapevines

verses.text: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتۡرَابٗا
verses.transliteration: WakawaAAiba atraban
verses.translation: And young women [companions] of equal age.

verses.text: وَكَأۡسٗا دِهَاقٗا
verses.transliteration: Wakasan dihaqan
verses.translation: And a full cup.[1827]
verses.footnotes: [1827] Of wine which is delicious and does not intoxicate.

verses.text: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّـٰبٗا
verses.transliteration: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala kiththaban
verses.translation: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

verses.text: جَزَآءٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابٗا
verses.transliteration: Jazaan min rabbika AAataan hisaban
verses.translation: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,[1828]
verses.footnotes: [1828] i.e., as a result of both their own righteous deeds and the limitless generosity of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) . Another meaning is "a gift calculated [to be adequate]."

verses.text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
verses.transliteration: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alrrahmani la yamlikoona minhu khitaban
verses.translation: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.[1829]
verses.footnotes: [1829] None of Allāh's creatures can plead with Him on the Day of Judgement except by His permission.

verses.text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
verses.transliteration: Yawma yaqoomu alrroohu waalmalaikatu saffan la yatakallamoona illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waqala sawaban
verses.translation: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

verses.text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
verses.transliteration: Thalika alyawmu alhaqqu faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi maaban
verses.translation: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.[1830]
verses.footnotes: [1830] i.e., a direct route through correct beliefs and righteous deeds.

verses.text: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
verses.transliteration: Inna antharnakum AAathaban qareeban yawma yanthuru almaro ma qaddamat yadahu wayaqoolu alkafiru ya laytanee kuntu turaban
verses.translation: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth[1831] and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
verses.footnotes: [1831] i.e., the deeds he did in this world, which await him in the Hereafter.

verses.text: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَٰتِ غَرۡقٗا
verses.transliteration: WaalnnaziAAati gharqan
verses.translation: By those [angels] who extract with violence[1833]
verses.footnotes: [1833] i.e., those who tear out the souls of those destined for Hell.

verses.text: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَٰتِ نَشۡطٗا
verses.transliteration: Waalnnashitati nashtan
verses.translation: And [by] those who remove with ease[1834]
verses.footnotes: [1834] i.e., those angels who ease out the souls of those destined for Paradise.

verses.text: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَٰتِ سَبۡحٗا
verses.transliteration: Waalssabihati sabhan
verses.translation: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming[1835]
verses.footnotes: [1835] Speeding to execute Allāh's commands.

verses.text: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَٰتِ سَبۡقٗا
verses.transliteration: Faalssabiqati sabqan
verses.translation: And those who race each other in a race[1836]
verses.footnotes: [1836] Racing to deliver the souls of the believers to Paradise.

verses.text: فَٱلۡمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمۡرٗا
verses.transliteration: Faalmudabbirati amran
verses.translation: And those who arrange [each] matter,[1837]
verses.footnotes: [1837] According to Allāh's decree.

verses.text: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
verses.transliteration: Yawma tarjufu alrrajifatu
verses.translation: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

verses.text: تَتۡبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
verses.transliteration: TatbaAAuha alrradifatu
verses.translation: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

verses.text: قُلُوبٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَاجِفَةٌ
verses.transliteration: Quloobun yawmaithin wajifatun
verses.translation: Hearts,[1838] that Day, will tremble,
verses.footnotes: [1838] Those of the disbelievers who denied the Resurrection.

verses.text: أَبۡصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٞ
verses.transliteration: Absaruha khashiAAatun
verses.translation: Their eyes[1839] humbled.
verses.footnotes: [1839] Those of the disbelievers.

verses.text: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرۡدُودُونَ فِي ٱلۡحَافِرَةِ
verses.transliteration: Yaqooloona ainna lamardoodoona fee alhafirati
verses.translation: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

verses.text: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمٗا نَّخِرَةٗ
verses.transliteration: Aitha kunna AAithaman nakhiratan
verses.translation: Even if we should be decayed bones?"[1840]
verses.footnotes: [1840] The disbelievers say this in ridicule of the warning.

verses.text: قَالُواْ تِلۡكَ إِذٗا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٞ
verses.transliteration: Qaloo tilka ithan karratun khasiratun
verses.translation: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."[1841]
verses.footnotes: [1841] i.e., "If that were so, we would not be able to escape punishment."

verses.text: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ
verses.transliteration: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun
verses.translation: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

verses.text: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
verses.transliteration: Faitha hum bialssahirati
verses.translation: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

verses.text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu moosa
verses.translation: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

verses.text: إِذۡ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verses.transliteration: Ith nadahu rabbuhu bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan
verses.translation: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,

verses.text: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha
verses.translation: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

verses.text: فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Faqul hal laka ila an tazakka
verses.translation: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself

verses.text: وَأَهۡدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخۡشَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waahdiyaka ila rabbika fatakhsha
verses.translation: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

verses.text: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلۡأٓيَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Faarahu alayata alkubra
verses.translation: And he showed him the greatest sign,[1842]
verses.footnotes: [1842] i.e., the miracle of his staff becoming a great snake.

verses.text: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fakaththaba waAAasa
verses.translation: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.

verses.text: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ يَسۡعَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Thumma adbara yasAAa
verses.translation: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].[1843]
verses.footnotes: [1843] An alternative meaning is "running [from the snake]."

verses.text: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fahashara fanada
verses.translation: And he gathered [his people] and called out

verses.text: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Faqala ana rabbukumu alaAAla
verses.translation: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

verses.text: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Faakhathahu Allahu nakala alakhirati waaloola
verses.translation: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].[1844].
verses.footnotes: [1844] i.e., for Pharaoh's setting himself up as a deity and for his previous oppression of the people and denial of Moses.

verses.text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laAAibratan liman yakhsha
verses.translation: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].

verses.text: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Aantum ashaddu khalqan ami alssamao banaha
verses.translation: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.

verses.text: رَفَعَ سَمۡكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: RafaAAa samkaha fasawwaha
verses.translation: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

verses.text: وَأَغۡطَشَ لَيۡلَهَا وَأَخۡرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Waaghtasha laylaha waakhraja duhaha
verses.translation: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.[1845]
verses.footnotes: [1845] i.e., created the day from within the surrounding darkness.

verses.text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
verses.transliteration: Waalarda baAAda thalika dahaha
verses.translation: And after that He spread the earth.

verses.text: أَخۡرَجَ مِنۡهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرۡعَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Akhraja minha maaha wamarAAaha
verses.translation: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

verses.text: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَرۡسَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Waaljibala arsaha
verses.translation: And the mountains He set firmly

verses.text: مَتَٰعٗا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ
verses.transliteration: MataAAan lakum walianAAamikum
verses.translation: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

verses.text: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Faitha jaati alttammatu alkubra
verses.translation: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity[1846] -
verses.footnotes: [1846] i.e., the Day of Resurrection.

verses.text: يَوۡمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Yawma yatathakkaru alinsanu ma saAAa
verses.translation: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

verses.text: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waburrizati aljaheemu liman yara
verses.translation: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

verses.text: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Faamma man tagha
verses.translation: So as for he who transgressed

verses.text: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
verses.transliteration: Waathara alhayata alddunya
verses.translation: And preferred the life of the world,

verses.text: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fainna aljaheema hiya almawa
verses.translation: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

verses.text: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waama man khafa maqama rabbihi wanaha alnnafsa AAani alhawa
verses.translation: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord[1847] and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
verses.footnotes: [1847] See footnote to 55:46.

verses.text: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fainna aljannata hiya almawa
verses.translation: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

verses.text: يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرۡسَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Yasaloonaka AAani alssaAAati ayyana mursaha
verses.translation: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?[1848]
verses.footnotes: [1848] Literally, "resting" or "establishment."

verses.text: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكۡرَىٰهَآ
verses.transliteration: Feema anta min thikraha
verses.translation: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?[1849]
verses.footnotes: [1849] Meaning that Muḥammad (ﷺ) had no knowledge of it, so how could he inform them?

verses.text: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
verses.transliteration: Ila rabbika muntahaha
verses.translation: To your Lord is its finality.[1850]
verses.footnotes: [1850] i.e., its destination and termination. And to Him belongs ultimate knowledge of it.

verses.text: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Innama anta munthiru man yakhshaha
verses.translation: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

verses.text: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Kaannahum yawma yarawnaha lam yalbathoo illa AAashiyyatan aw duhaha
verses.translation: It will be, on the Day they see it,[1851] as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
verses.footnotes: [1851] i.e., the Hour, the Resurrection.

verses.text: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: AAabasa watawalla
verses.translation: He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away

verses.text: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ
verses.transliteration: An jaahu alaAAma
verses.translation: Because there came to him the blind man,[1853] [interrupting].
verses.footnotes: [1853] ʿAbdullāh, the son of Umm Maktūm.

verses.text: وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Wama yudreeka laAAallahu yazzakka
verses.translation: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified[1854]
verses.footnotes: [1854] As a result of what he learns from you.

verses.text: أَوۡ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Aw yaththakkaru fatanfaAAahu alththikra
verses.translation: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

verses.text: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Amma mani istaghna
verses.translation: As for he who thinks himself without need,[1855]
verses.footnotes: [1855] i.e., without need of faith or need of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) . Here it is in reference to a certain influential member of the Quraysh whom the Prophet (ﷺ) had hoped to bring to Islām.

verses.text: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Faanta lahu tasadda
verses.translation: To him you give attention.

verses.text: وَمَا عَلَيۡكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wama AAalayka alla yazzakka
verses.translation: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.[1856]
verses.footnotes: [1856] The Prophet (ﷺ) was responsible only for conveying the message, not for ultimate guidance.

verses.text: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسۡعَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waamma man jaaka yasAAa
verses.translation: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

verses.text: وَهُوَ يَخۡشَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa yakhsha
verses.translation: While he fears [Allāh],

verses.text: فَأَنتَ عَنۡهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Faanta AAanhu talahha
verses.translation: From him you are distracted.

verses.text: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذۡكِرَةٞ
verses.transliteration: Kalla innaha tathkiratun
verses.translation: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;

verses.text: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
verses.transliteration: Faman shaa thakarahu
verses.translation: So whoever wills may remember it.[1857]
verses.footnotes: [1857] The revelation. Or "Him," i.e., Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) .

verses.text: فِي صُحُفٖ مُّكَرَّمَةٖ
verses.transliteration: Fee suhufin mukarramatin
verses.translation: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,

verses.text: مَّرۡفُوعَةٖ مُّطَهَّرَةِۭ
verses.transliteration: MarfooAAatin mutahharatin
verses.translation: Exalted and purified,

verses.text: بِأَيۡدِي سَفَرَةٖ
verses.transliteration: Biaydee safaratin
verses.translation: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,

verses.text: كِرَامِۭ بَرَرَةٖ
verses.transliteration: Kiramin bararatin
verses.translation: Noble and dutiful.

verses.text: قُتِلَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكۡفَرَهُۥ
verses.transliteration: Qutila alinsanu ma akfarahu
verses.translation: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] is man;[1858] how disbelieving is he.
verses.footnotes: [1858] i.e., those who deny Allāh's message.

verses.text: مِنۡ أَيِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
verses.transliteration: Min ayyi shayin khalaqahu
verses.translation: From what thing [i.e., substance] did He create him?

verses.text: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
verses.transliteration: Min nutfatin khalaqahu faqaddarahu
verses.translation: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;[1859]
verses.footnotes: [1859] His proportions, provisions, life span, etc.

verses.text: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
verses.transliteration: Thumma alssabeela yassarahu
verses.translation: Then He eased the way for him;[1860]
verses.footnotes: [1860] Into this world (i.e., his birth) . It may also refer to life itself, which has been made easier by Allāh's guidance.

verses.text: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقۡبَرَهُۥ
verses.transliteration: Thumma amatahu faaqbarahu
verses.translation: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.[1861]
verses.footnotes: [1861] To conceal his decaying body.

verses.text: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
verses.transliteration: Thumma itha shaa ansharahu
verses.translation: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

verses.text: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقۡضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
verses.transliteration: Kalla lamma yaqdi ma amarahu
verses.translation: No! He [i.e., man] has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.

verses.text: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
verses.transliteration: Falyanthuri alinsanu ila taAAamihi
verses.translation: Then let mankind look at his food -

verses.text: أَنَّا صَبَبۡنَا ٱلۡمَآءَ صَبّٗا
verses.transliteration: Anna sababna almaa sabban
verses.translation: How We poured down water in torrents,

verses.text: ثُمَّ شَقَقۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ شَقّٗا
verses.transliteration: Thumma shaqaqna alarda shaqqan
verses.translation: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

verses.text: فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا حَبّٗا
verses.transliteration: Faanbatna feeha habban
verses.translation: And caused to grow within it grain

verses.text: وَعِنَبٗا وَقَضۡبٗا
verses.transliteration: WaAAinaban waqadban
verses.translation: And grapes and herbage

verses.text: وَزَيۡتُونٗا وَنَخۡلٗا
verses.transliteration: Wazaytoonan wanakhlan
verses.translation: And olive and palm trees

verses.text: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلۡبٗا
verses.transliteration: Wahadaiqa ghulban
verses.translation: And gardens of dense shrubbery

verses.text: وَفَٰكِهَةٗ وَأَبّٗا
verses.transliteration: Wafakihatan waabban
verses.translation: And fruit and grass -

verses.text: مَّتَٰعٗا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ
verses.transliteration: MataAAan lakum walianAAamikum
verses.translation: [As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

verses.text: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
verses.transliteration: Faitha jaati alssakhkhatu
verses.translation: But when there comes the Deafening Blast[1862]
verses.footnotes: [1862] The piercing blast of the Horn which signals resurrection. Aṣ-Ṣākhkhah is also a name for the Day of Resurrection.

verses.text: يَوۡمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مِنۡ أَخِيهِ
verses.transliteration: Yawma yafirru almaro min akheehi
verses.translation: On the Day a man will flee from his brother

verses.text: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
verses.transliteration: Waommihi waabeehi
verses.translation: And his mother and his father

verses.text: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
verses.transliteration: Wasahibatihi wabaneehi
verses.translation: And his wife and his children,

verses.text: لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ شَأۡنٞ يُغۡنِيهِ
verses.transliteration: Likulli imriin minhum yawmaithin shanun yughneehi
verses.translation: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.[1863]
verses.footnotes: [1863] i.e., to occupy him. He will be concerned only with himself, thus forgetting all others.

verses.text: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ مُّسۡفِرَةٞ
verses.transliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin musfiratun
verses.translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -

verses.text: ضَاحِكَةٞ مُّسۡتَبۡشِرَةٞ
verses.transliteration: Dahikatun mustabshiratun
verses.translation: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.

verses.text: وَوُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَلَيۡهَا غَبَرَةٞ
verses.transliteration: Wawujoohun yawmaithin AAalayha ghabaratun
verses.translation: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.

verses.text: تَرۡهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
verses.transliteration: Tarhaquha qataratun
verses.translation: Blackness will cover them.

verses.text: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡكَفَرَةُ ٱلۡفَجَرَةُ
verses.transliteration: Olaika humu alkafaratu alfajaratu
verses.translation: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.

verses.text: إِذَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ كُوِّرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Itha alshshamsu kuwwirat
verses.translation: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha alnnujoomu inkadarat
verses.translation: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha aljibalu suyyirat
verses.translation: And when the mountains are removed

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha alAAisharu AAuttilat
verses.translation: And when full-term she-camels[1865] are neglected
verses.footnotes: [1865] Those ten months pregnant and nearing delivery. This verse alludes to distraction from the most valued of possessions.

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha alwuhooshu hushirat
verses.translation: And when the wild beasts are gathered

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha albiharu sujjirat
verses.translation: And when the seas are filled with flame[1866]
verses.footnotes: [1866] Or "when the seas have overflowed [into each other]."

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha alnnufoosu zuwwijat
verses.translation: And when the souls are paired[1867]
verses.footnotes: [1867] With another like soul. It can also mean "joined" (with their groups or sects) .

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡمَوۡءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha almawoodatu suilat
verses.translation: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

verses.text: بِأَيِّ ذَنۢبٖ قُتِلَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Biayyi thanbin qutilat
verses.translation: For what sin she was killed

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha alssuhufu nushirat
verses.translation: And when the pages[1868] are spread [i.e., made public]
verses.footnotes: [1868] On which are recorded the deeds of all people.

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha alssamao kushitat
verses.translation: And when the sky is stripped away

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha aljaheemu suAAAAirat
verses.translation: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَنَّةُ أُزۡلِفَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha aljannatu ozlifat
verses.translation: And when Paradise is brought near,

verses.text: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّآ أَحۡضَرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: AAalimat nafsun ma ahdarat
verses.translation: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].[1869]
verses.footnotes: [1869] i.e., all of one's deeds from worldly life, which have accompanied the soul to the Hereafter.

verses.text: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلۡخُنَّسِ
verses.transliteration: Fala oqsimu bialkhunnasi
verses.translation: So I swear by the retreating stars -

verses.text: ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡكُنَّسِ
verses.transliteration: Aljawari alkunnasi
verses.translation: Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]

verses.text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا عَسۡعَسَ
verses.transliteration: Waallayli itha AAasAAasa
verses.translation: And by the night as it closes in[1870]
verses.footnotes: [1870] An alternative meaning is "as it departs."

verses.text: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
verses.transliteration: Waalssubhi itha tanaffasa
verses.translation: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُولٖ كَرِيمٖ
verses.transliteration: Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareemin
verses.translation: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]

verses.text: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٖ
verses.transliteration: Thee quwwatin AAinda thee alAAarshi makeenin
verses.translation: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

verses.text: مُّطَاعٖ ثَمَّ أَمِينٖ
verses.transliteration: MutaAAin thamma ameenin
verses.translation: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

verses.text: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجۡنُونٖ
verses.transliteration: Wama sahibukum bimajnoonin
verses.translation: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.[1871]
verses.footnotes: [1871] Literally, "possessed by jinn."

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad raahu bialofuqi almubeeni
verses.translation: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.[1872]
verses.footnotes: [1872] i.e., the eastern horizon, where the sun rises. See footnote to 53:6.

verses.text: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلۡغَيۡبِ بِضَنِينٖ
verses.transliteration: Wama huwa AAala alghaybi bidaneenin
verses.translation: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.[1873]
verses.footnotes: [1873] Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) did not withhold that knowledge of the unseen which Allāh had revealed to him in the Qur’ān.

verses.text: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَيۡطَٰنٖ رَّجِيمٖ
verses.transliteration: Wama huwa biqawli shaytanin rajeemin
verses.translation: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

verses.text: فَأَيۡنَ تَذۡهَبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faayna tathhaboona
verses.translation: So where are you going?[1874]
verses.footnotes: [1874] In your denial of the Qur’ān and in your accusations against the Prophet (ﷺ) . The meaning is essentially "Surely, you have strayed far from Allāh's path."

verses.text: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena
verses.translation: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

verses.text: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَسۡتَقِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Liman shaa minkum an yastaqeema
verses.translation: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

verses.text: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu rabbu alAAalameena
verses.translation: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.

verses.text: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Itha alssamao infatarat
verses.translation: When the sky breaks apart

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha alkawakibu intatharat
verses.translation: And when the stars fall, scattering,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha albiharu fujjirat
verses.translation: And when the seas are erupted

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡقُبُورُ بُعۡثِرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha alqubooru buAAthirat
verses.translation: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],

verses.text: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ وَأَخَّرَتۡ
verses.transliteration: AAalimat nafsun ma qaddamat waakhkharat
verses.translation: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

verses.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareemi
verses.translation: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
verses.transliteration: Allathee khalaqaka fasawwaka faAAadalaka
verses.translation: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

verses.text: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةٖ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
verses.transliteration: Fee ayyi sooratin ma shaa rakkabaka
verses.translation: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

verses.text: كَلَّا بَلۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Kalla bal tukaththiboona bialddeeni
verses.translation: No! But you deny the Recompense.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wainna AAalaykum lahafitheena
verses.translation: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,[1876]
verses.footnotes: [1876] Angels who preserve the deeds of men in records.

verses.text: كِرَامٗا كَٰتِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Kiraman katibeena
verses.translation: Noble and recording;

verses.text: يَعۡلَمُونَ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: YaAAlamoona ma tafAAaloona
verses.translation: They know whatever you do.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٖ
verses.transliteration: Inna alabrara lafee naAAeemin
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

verses.text: وَإِنَّ ٱلۡفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٖ
verses.transliteration: Wainna alfujjara lafee jaheemin
verses.translation: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

verses.text: يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Yaslawnaha yawma alddeeni
verses.translation: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

verses.text: وَمَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wama hum AAanha bighaibeena
verses.translation: And never therefrom will they be absent.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Wama adraka ma yawmu alddeeni
verses.translation: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

verses.text: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Thumma ma adraka ma yawmu alddeeni
verses.translation: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

verses.text: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٞ لِّنَفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ
verses.transliteration: Yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan waalamru yawmaithin lillahi
verses.translation: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُطَفِّفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waylun lilmutaffifeena
verses.translation: Woe to those who give less [than due],[1878]
verses.footnotes: [1878] i.e., those who cheat people by giving them less than what they paid for when weighing or measuring - an amount so little as to hardly be noticed.

verses.text: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Allatheena itha iktaloo AAala alnnasi yastawfoona
verses.translation: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

verses.text: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمۡ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمۡ يُخۡسِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waitha kaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroona
verses.translation: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

verses.text: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبۡعُوثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ala yathunnu olaika annahum mabAAoothoona
verses.translation: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

verses.text: لِيَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
verses.transliteration: Liyawmin AAatheemin
verses.translation: For a tremendous Day -

verses.text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma yaqoomu alnnasu lirabbi alAAalameena
verses.translation: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

verses.text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٖ
verses.transliteration: Kalla inna kitaba alfujjari lafee sijjeenin
verses.translation: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٞ
verses.transliteration: Wama adraka ma sijjeenun
verses.translation: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

verses.text: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ
verses.transliteration: Kitabun marqoomun
verses.translation: It is [their destination[1879] recorded in] a register inscribed.
verses.footnotes: [1879] The lowest depths of Hell.

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

verses.text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Allatheena yukaththiboona biyawmi alddeeni
verses.translation: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

verses.text: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Wama yukaththibu bihi illa kullu muAAtadin atheemin
verses.translation: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

verses.text: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena
verses.translation: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

verses.text: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kalla bal rana AAala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona
verses.translation: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.[1880]
verses.footnotes: [1880] i.e., their sins.

verses.text: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kalla innahum AAan rabbihim yawmaithin lamahjooboona
verses.translation: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.[1881]
verses.footnotes: [1881] i.e., they will not be able to see Him.

verses.text: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمۡ لَصَالُواْ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Thumma innahum lasaloo aljaheemi
verses.translation: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

verses.text: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma yuqalu hatha allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
verses.translation: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

verses.text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.transliteration: Kalla inna kitaba alabrari lafee AAilliyyeena
verses.translation: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
verses.transliteration: Wama adraka ma AAilliyyoona
verses.translation: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?

verses.text: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ
verses.transliteration: Kitabun marqoomun
verses.translation: It is [their destination[1882] recorded in] a register inscribed
verses.footnotes: [1882] The highest elevations of Paradise.

verses.text: يَشۡهَدُهُ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yashhaduhu almuqarraboona
verses.translation: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Inna alabrara lafee naAAeemin
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

verses.text: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: AAala alaraiki yanthuroona
verses.translation: On adorned couches, observing.

verses.text: تَعۡرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمۡ نَضۡرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.transliteration: TaAArifu fee wujoohihim nadrata alnnaAAeemi
verses.translation: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

verses.text: يُسۡقَوۡنَ مِن رَّحِيقٖ مَّخۡتُومٍ
verses.transliteration: Yusqawna min raheeqin makhtoomin
verses.translation: They will be given to drink [pure] wine[1883] [which was] sealed.
verses.footnotes: [1883] Which is delicious and does not intoxicate.

verses.text: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكٞۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
verses.transliteration: Khitamuhu miskun wafee thalika falyatanafasi almutanafisoona
verses.translation: The last of it[1884] is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
verses.footnotes: [1884] i.e., its lingering odor.

verses.text: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسۡنِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Wamizajuhu min tasneemin
verses.translation: And its mixture is of Tasneem,[1885]
verses.footnotes: [1885] The highest spring in Paradise and the most favored drink of its inhabitants.

verses.text: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: AAaynan yashrabu biha almuqarraboona
verses.translation: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoo mina allatheena amanoo yadhakoona
verses.translation: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

verses.text: وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِهِمۡ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waitha marroo bihim yataghamazoona
verses.translation: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waitha inqalaboo ila ahlihimu inqalaboo fakiheena
verses.translation: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

verses.text: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.transliteration: Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona
verses.translation: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."

verses.text: وَمَآ أُرۡسِلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wama orsiloo AAalayhim hafitheena
verses.translation: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

verses.text: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faalyawma allatheena amanoo mina alkuffari yadhakoona
verses.translation: So Today[1886] those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
verses.footnotes: [1886] On the Day of Judgement.

verses.text: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: AAala alaraiki yanthuroona
verses.translation: On adorned couches, observing.

verses.text: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanoo yafAAaloona
verses.translation: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?

verses.text: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتۡ
verses.transliteration: Itha alssamao inshaqqat
verses.translation: When the sky has split [open]

verses.text: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waathinat lirabbiha wahuqqat
verses.translation: And has listened [i.e., responded][1888] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.footnotes: [1888] It will have heard Allāh's command and will have inclined immediately to compliance and willing obedience.

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مُدَّتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waitha alardu muddat
verses.translation: And when the earth has been extended[1889]
verses.footnotes: [1889] i.e., stretched flat and spread out.

verses.text: وَأَلۡقَتۡ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waalqat ma feeha watakhallat
verses.translation: And has cast out that within it[1890] and relinquished [it]
verses.footnotes: [1890] Of the dead and all else buried therein.

verses.text: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waathinat lirabbiha wahuqqat
verses.translation: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] –

verses.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
verses.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alinsanu innaka kadihun ila rabbika kadhan famulaqeehi
verses.translation: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion[1891] and will meet it.[1892]
verses.footnotes:
[1891] i.e., striving throughout your life until you meet your Lord, hastening toward death.
[1892] i.e., you will find all that you intended and accomplished awaiting you in the Hereafter. Another meaning is "And will meet Him [i.e., your Lord]" and be recompensed in full by Him.

verses.text: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
verses.transliteration: Faama man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi
verses.translation: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

verses.text: فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابٗا يَسِيرٗا
verses.transliteration: Fasawfa yuhasabu hisaban yaseeran
verses.translation: He will be judged with an easy account

verses.text: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورٗا
verses.transliteration: Wayanqalibu ila ahlihi masrooran
verses.translation: And return to his people in happiness.

verses.text: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
verses.transliteration: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu waraa thahrihi
verses.translation: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

verses.text: فَسَوۡفَ يَدۡعُواْ ثُبُورٗا
verses.transliteration: Fasawfa yadAAoo thubooran
verses.translation: He will cry out for destruction

verses.text: وَيَصۡلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Wayasla saAAeeran
verses.translation: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورًا
verses.transliteration: Innahu kana fee ahlihi masrooran
verses.translation: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
verses.transliteration: Innahu thanna an lan yahoora
verses.translation: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].

verses.text: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرٗا
verses.transliteration: Bala inna rabbahu kana bihi baseeran
verses.translation: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.

verses.text: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
verses.transliteration: Fala oqsimu bialshshafaqi
verses.translation: So I swear by the twilight glow

verses.text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
verses.transliteration: Waallayli wama wasaqa
verses.translation: And [by] the night and what it envelops

verses.text: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
verses.transliteration: Waalqamari itha ittasaqa
verses.translation: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

verses.text: لَتَرۡكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٖ
verses.transliteration: Latarkabunna tabaqan AAan tabaqin
verses.translation: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.[1893]
verses.footnotes: [1893] i.e., various stages, both in this life and in the Hereafter.

verses.text: فَمَا لَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fama lahum la yuminoona
verses.translation: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

verses.text: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
verses.transliteration: Waitha quria AAalayhimu alquranu la yasjudoona
verses.translation: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?

verses.text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Bali allatheena kafaroo yukaththiboona
verses.translation: But those who have disbelieved deny,

verses.text: وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
verses.transliteration: WaAllahu aAAlamu bima yooAAoona
verses.translation: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

verses.text: فَبَشِّرۡهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Fabashshirhum biAAathabin aleemin
verses.translation: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

verses.text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
verses.transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin
verses.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.

verses.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡبُرُوجِ
verses.transliteration: Waalssamai thati alburooji
verses.translation: By the sky containing great stars

verses.text: وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡمَوۡعُودِ
verses.transliteration: Waalyawmi almawAAoodi
verses.translation: And [by] the promised Day

verses.text: وَشَاهِدٖ وَمَشۡهُودٖ
verses.transliteration: Washahidin wamashhoodin
verses.translation: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

verses.text: قُتِلَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأُخۡدُودِ
verses.transliteration: Qutila ashabu alukhdoodi
verses.translation: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench[1895]
verses.footnotes: [1895] Or "May they be destroyed" or "cursed." The "companions of the trench" (or ditch) were agents of a tyrannical king who refused to allow his people to believe in Allāh. Their evil deed in obedience to their ruler earned for them the curse of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) .

verses.text: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡوَقُودِ
verses.transliteration: Alnnari thati alwaqoodi
verses.translation: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,

verses.text: إِذۡ هُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا قُعُودٞ
verses.transliteration: Ith hum AAalayha quAAoodun
verses.translation: When they were sitting near it.

verses.text: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ
verses.transliteration: Wahum AAala ma yafAAaloona bialmumineena shuhoodun
verses.translation: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses. [1896]
verses.footnotes: [1896] After casting the believers into a trench filled with fire, they sat at its edge, watching them burn to death. This event occurred before the time of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) .

verses.text: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wama naqamoo minhum illa an yuminoo biAllahi alAAazeezi alhameedi
verses.translation: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waAllahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun
verses.translation: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.[1897]
verses.footnotes: [1897] See footnote to 4:79.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
verses.transliteration: Inna allatheena fatanoo almumineena waalmuminati thumma lam yatooboo falahum AAathabu jahannama walahum AAathabu alhareeqi
verses.translation: Indeed, those who have tortured[1898] the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
verses.footnotes: [1898] Or, in this instance, the literal meaning of "burned" is also appropriate.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu thalika alfawzu alkabeeru
verses.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

verses.text: إِنَّ بَطۡشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Inna batsha rabbika lashadeedun
verses.translation: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبۡدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
verses.transliteration: Innahu huwa yubdio wayuAAeedu
verses.translation: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

verses.text: وَهُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلۡوَدُودُ
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa alghafooru alwadoodu
verses.translation: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

verses.text: ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡمَجِيدُ
verses.transliteration: Thoo alAAarshi almajeedi
verses.translation: Honorable Owner of the Throne,

verses.text: فَعَّالٞ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
verses.transliteration: FaAAAAalun lima yureedu
verses.translation: Effecter of what He intends.

verses.text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡجُنُودِ
verses.transliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu aljunoodi
verses.translation: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -

verses.text: فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَثَمُودَ
verses.transliteration: FirAAawna wathamooda
verses.translation: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamūd?

verses.text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي تَكۡذِيبٖ
verses.transliteration: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee taktheebin
verses.translation: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,

verses.text: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطُۢ
verses.transliteration: WaAllahu min waraihim muheetun
verses.translation: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.[1899]
verses.footnotes: [1899] See footnote to 2:19

verses.text: بَلۡ هُوَ قُرۡءَانٞ مَّجِيدٞ
verses.transliteration: Bal huwa quranun majeedun
verses.translation: But this is an honored Qur’ān

verses.text: فِي لَوۡحٖ مَّحۡفُوظِۭ
verses.transliteration: Fee lawhin mahfoothin
verses.translation: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.

verses.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
verses.transliteration: Waalssamai waalttariqi
verses.translation: By the sky and the knocker

verses.text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
verses.transliteration: Wama adraka ma alttariqu
verses.translation: And what can make you know what is the knocker?

verses.text: ٱلنَّجۡمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
verses.transliteration: Alnnajmu alththaqibu
verses.translation: It is the piercing star[1901].
verses.footnotes: [1901] Whose light pierces through the darkness.

verses.text: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٞ
verses.transliteration: In kullu nafsin lamma AAalayha hafithun
verses.translation: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

verses.text: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
verses.transliteration: Falyanthuri alinsanu mimma khuliqa
verses.translation: So let man observe from what he was created.

verses.text: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٖ دَافِقٖ
verses.transliteration: Khuliqa min main dafiqin
verses.translation: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

verses.text: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ ٱلصُّلۡبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
verses.transliteration: Yakhruju min bayni alssulbi waalttaraibi
verses.translation: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجۡعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٞ
verses.transliteration: Innahu AAala rajAAihi laqadirun
verses.translation: Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.

verses.text: يَوۡمَ تُبۡلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
verses.transliteration: Yawma tubla alssarairu
verses.translation: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,[1902]
verses.footnotes: [1902] i.e., exposed, examined and judged.

verses.text: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٖ وَلَا نَاصِرٖ
verses.transliteration: Fama lahu min quwwatin wala nasirin
verses.translation: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.

verses.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجۡعِ
verses.transliteration: Waalssamai thati alrrajAAi
verses.translation: By the sky which sends back[1903]
verses.footnotes: [1903] Rain, heat, sound waves, etc.

verses.text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدۡعِ
verses.transliteration: Waalardi thati alssadAAi
verses.translation: And [by] the earth which splits,[1904]
verses.footnotes: [1904] With plant growth or from geological rifts.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلٞ فَصۡلٞ
verses.transliteration: Innahu laqawlun faslun
verses.translation: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,

verses.text: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلۡهَزۡلِ
verses.transliteration: Wama huwa bialhazli
verses.translation: And it is not amusement.

verses.text: إِنَّهُمۡ يَكِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗا
verses.transliteration: Innahum yakeedoona kaydan
verses.translation: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

verses.text: وَأَكِيدُ كَيۡدٗا
verses.transliteration: Waakeedu kaydan
verses.translation: But I am planning a plan.

verses.text: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡهِلۡهُمۡ رُوَيۡدَۢا
verses.transliteration: Famahhili alkafireena amhilhum ruwaydan
verses.translation: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.[1905]
verses.footnotes: [1905] i.e., Do not be in haste for revenge, for you will see what will become of them.

verses.text: سَبِّحِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَى
verses.transliteration: Sabbihi isma rabbika alaAAla
verses.translation: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Allathee khalaqa fasawwa
verses.translation: Who created and proportioned

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waallathee qaddara fahada
verses.translation: And who destined and [then] guided

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَخۡرَجَ ٱلۡمَرۡعَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waallathee akhraja almarAAa
verses.translation: And who brings out the pasture

verses.text: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحۡوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: FajaAAalahu ghuthaan ahwa
verses.translation: And [then] makes it black stubble.

verses.text: سَنُقۡرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Sanuqrioka fala tansa
verses.translation: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget,

verses.text: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Illa ma shaa Allahu innahu yaAAlamu aljahra wama yakhfa
verses.translation: Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

verses.text: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wanuyassiruka lilyusra
verses.translation: And We will ease you toward ease.[1907]
verses.footnotes: [1907] To the path of Allāh's religion, which is easy and natural, or toward Paradise, by giving opportunities for righteous deeds.

verses.text: فَذَكِّرۡ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fathakkir in nafaAAati alththikra
verses.translation: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;[1908]
verses.footnotes: [1908] i.e., wherever it will be heard and understood.

verses.text: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Sayaththakkaru man yakhsha
verses.translation: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.

verses.text: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى
verses.transliteration: Wayatajannabuha alashqa
verses.translation: But the wretched one will avoid it –

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي يَصۡلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Allathee yasla alnnara alkubra
verses.translation: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

verses.text: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Thumma la yamootu feeha wala yahya
verses.translation: Neither dying therein nor living.

verses.text: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qad aflaha man tazakka
verses.translation: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

verses.text: وَذَكَرَ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wathakara isma rabbihi fasalla
verses.translation: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

verses.text: بَلۡ تُؤۡثِرُونَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
verses.transliteration: Bal tuthiroona alhayata alddunya
verses.translation: But you prefer the worldly life,

verses.text: وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Waalakhiratu khayrun waabqa
verses.translation: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

verses.text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Inna hatha lafee alssuhufi aloola
verses.translation: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

verses.text: صُحُفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Suhufi ibraheema wamoosa
verses.translation: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

verses.text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡغَٰشِيَةِ
verses.transliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu alghashiyati
verses.translation: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?

verses.text: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
verses.transliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin khashiAAatun
verses.translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,

verses.text: عَامِلَةٞ نَّاصِبَةٞ
verses.transliteration: AAamilatun nasibatun
verses.translation: Working [hard] and exhausted.[1910]
verses.footnotes: [1910] Another accepted meaning is "They were working hard and exhausted," i.e., doing deeds during worldly life which did not benefit them since they were not accompanied by faith or done for the acceptance of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) .

verses.text: تَصۡلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةٗ
verses.transliteration: Tasla naran hamiyatan
verses.translation: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.

verses.text: تُسۡقَىٰ مِنۡ عَيۡنٍ ءَانِيَةٖ
verses.transliteration: Tusqa min AAaynin aniyatin
verses.translation: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

verses.text: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٖ
verses.transliteration: Laysa lahum taAAamun illa min dareeAAin
verses.translation: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

verses.text: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعٖ
verses.transliteration: La yusminu wala yughnee min jooAAin
verses.translation: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.

verses.text: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ نَّاعِمَةٞ
verses.transliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin naAAimatun
verses.translation: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.

verses.text: لِّسَعۡيِهَا رَاضِيَةٞ
verses.transliteration: LisaAAyiha radiyatun
verses.translation: With their effort [they are] satisfied

verses.text: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٖ
verses.transliteration: Fee jannatin AAaliyatin
verses.translation: In an elevated garden,

verses.text: لَّا تَسۡمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةٗ
verses.transliteration: La tasmaAAu feeha laghiyatan
verses.translation: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.[1911]
verses.footnotes: [1911] i.e., any insult, falsehood, immorality, idle or vain talk, etc.

verses.text: فِيهَا عَيۡنٞ جَارِيَةٞ
verses.transliteration: Feeha AAaynun jariyatun
verses.translation: Within it is a flowing spring.

verses.text: فِيهَا سُرُرٞ مَّرۡفُوعَةٞ
verses.transliteration: Feeha sururun marfooAAatun
verses.translation: Within it are couches raised high

verses.text: وَأَكۡوَابٞ مَّوۡضُوعَةٞ
verses.transliteration: Waakwabun mawdooAAatun
verses.translation: And cups put in place

verses.text: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصۡفُوفَةٞ
verses.transliteration: Wanamariqu masfoofatun
verses.translation: And cushions lined up

verses.text: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبۡثُوثَةٌ
verses.transliteration: Wazarabiyyu mabthoothatun
verses.translation: And carpets spread around.

verses.text: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Afala yanthuroona ila alibili kayfa khuliqat
verses.translation: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?

verses.text: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ رُفِعَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waila alssamai kayfa rufiAAat
verses.translation: And at the sky - how it is raised?

verses.text: وَإِلَى ٱلۡجِبَالِ كَيۡفَ نُصِبَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waila aljibali kayfa nusibat
verses.translation: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

verses.text: وَإِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَيۡفَ سُطِحَتۡ
verses.transliteration: Waila alardi kayfa sutihat
verses.translation: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

verses.text: فَذَكِّرۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٞ
verses.transliteration: Fathakkir innama anta muthakkirun
verses.translation: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.

verses.text: لَّسۡتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِمُصَيۡطِرٍ
verses.transliteration: Lasta AAalayhim bimusaytirin
verses.translation: You are not over them a controller.

verses.text: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
verses.transliteration: Illa man tawalla wakafara
verses.translation: However, he who turns away and disbelieves –

verses.text: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرَ
verses.transliteration: FayuAAaththibuhu Allahu alAAathaba alakbara
verses.translation: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

verses.text: إِنَّ إِلَيۡنَآ إِيَابَهُمۡ
verses.transliteration: Inna ilayna iyabahum
verses.translation: Indeed, to Us is their return.

verses.text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا حِسَابَهُم
verses.transliteration: Thumma inna AAalayna hisabahum
verses.translation: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.

verses.text: وَٱلۡفَجۡرِ
verses.transliteration: Waalfajri
verses.translation: By the dawn

verses.text: وَلَيَالٍ عَشۡرٖ
verses.transliteration: Walayalin AAashrin
verses.translation: And [by] ten nights[1913]
verses.footnotes: [1913] Usually interpreted as the first ten nights of the month of Dhul-Ḥijjah.

verses.text: وَٱلشَّفۡعِ وَٱلۡوَتۡرِ
verses.transliteration: WaalshshafAAi waalwatri
verses.translation: And [by] the even [number] and the odd

verses.text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَسۡرِ
verses.transliteration: Waallayli itha yasri
verses.translation: And [by] the night when it passes,

verses.text: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٞ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
verses.transliteration: Hal fee thalika qasamun lithee hijrin
verses.translation: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?[1914]
verses.footnotes: [1914] Based upon the following verses, what has been sworn to by Allāh is that He will certainly punish the disbelievers.

verses.text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
verses.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biAAadin
verses.translation: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ʿAad -

verses.text: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلۡعِمَادِ
verses.transliteration: Irama thati alAAimadi
verses.translation: [With] Iram[1915] - who had lofty pillars,[1916]
verses.footnotes:
[1915] Another name for the first people of ʿAad, to whom Prophet Hūd was sent.
[1916] Supporting their tents or buildings.

verses.text: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
verses.transliteration: Allatee lam yukhlaq mithluha fee albiladi
verses.translation: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?

verses.text: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُواْ ٱلصَّخۡرَ بِٱلۡوَادِ
verses.transliteration: Wathamooda allatheena jaboo alssakhra bialwadi
verses.translation: And [with] Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the valley?

verses.text: وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ ذِي ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
verses.transliteration: WafirAAawna thee alawtadi
verses.translation: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes?[1917]
verses.footnotes: [1917] By which he tortured people.

verses.text: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
verses.transliteration: Allatheena taghaw fee albiladi
verses.translation: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands

verses.text: فَأَكۡثَرُواْ فِيهَا ٱلۡفَسَادَ
verses.transliteration: Faaktharoo feeha alfasada
verses.translation: And increased therein the corruption.

verses.text: فَصَبَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّكَ سَوۡطَ عَذَابٍ
verses.transliteration: Fasabba AAalayhim rabbuka sawta AAathabin
verses.translation: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

verses.text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلۡمِرۡصَادِ
verses.transliteration: Inna rabbaka labialmirsadi
verses.translation: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

verses.text: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
verses.transliteration: Faamma alinsanu itha ma ibtalahu rabbuhu faakramahu wanaAAAAamahu fayaqoolu rabbee akramani
verses.translation: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."[1918]
verses.footnotes: [1918] He is proud rather than grateful, attributing the favor to his own merit.

verses.text: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
verses.transliteration: Waamma itha ma ibtalahu faqadara AAalayhi rizqahu fayaqoolu rabbee ahanani
verses.translation: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

verses.text: كَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا تُكۡرِمُونَ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Kalla bal la tukrimoona alyateema
verses.translation: No![1919] But you do not honor the orphan
verses.footnotes: [1919] It is not like you imagine. Rather, Allāh tries people through prosperity and hardship and rewards both gratitude and patience with honor in the Hereafter.

verses.text: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
verses.transliteration: Wala tahaddoona AAala taAAami almiskeeni
verses.translation: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.

verses.text: وَتَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكۡلٗا لَّمّٗا
verses.transliteration: Watakuloona altturatha aklan lamman
verses.translation: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,[1920]
verses.footnotes: [1920] Not caring whether it is lawful or unlawful.

verses.text: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡمَالَ حُبّٗا جَمّٗا
verses.transliteration: Watuhibboona almala hubban jamman
verses.translation: And you love wealth with immense love.

verses.text: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكّٗا دَكّٗا
verses.transliteration: Kalla itha dukkati alardu dakkan dakkan
verses.translation: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed

verses.text: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفّٗا صَفّٗا
verses.transliteration: Wajaa rabbuka waalmalaku saffan saffan
verses.translation: And your Lord has come[1921] and the angels, rank upon rank,
verses.footnotes: [1921] To pass judgement. See footnote to 2:19.

verses.text: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wajeea yawmaithin bijahannama yawmaithin yatathakkaru alinsanu waanna lahu alththikra
verses.translation: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but how [i.e., what good] to him will be the remembrance?

verses.text: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي قَدَّمۡتُ لِحَيَاتِي
verses.transliteration: Yaqoolu ya laytanee qaddamtu lihayatee
verses.translation: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."[1922]
verses.footnotes: [1922] The everlasting life of the Hereafter.

verses.text: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ
verses.transliteration: Fayawmaithin la yuAAaththibu AAathabahu ahadun
verses.translation: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,

verses.text: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ
verses.transliteration: Wala yoothiqu wathaqahu ahadun
verses.translation: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].

verses.text: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفۡسُ ٱلۡمُطۡمَئِنَّةُ
verses.transliteration: Ya ayyatuha alnnafsu almutmainnatu
verses.translation: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,

verses.text: ٱرۡجِعِيٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةٗ مَّرۡضِيَّةٗ
verses.transliteration: IrjiAAee ila rabbiki radiyatan mardiyyatan
verses.translation: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],

verses.text: فَٱدۡخُلِي فِي عِبَٰدِي
verses.transliteration: Faodkhulee fee AAibadee
verses.translation: And enter among My [righteous] servants

verses.text: وَٱدۡخُلِي جَنَّتِي
verses.transliteration: Waodkhulee jannatee
verses.translation: And enter My Paradise."

verses.text: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ
verses.transliteration: La oqsimu bihatha albaladi
verses.translation: I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah] –

verses.text: وَأَنتَ حِلُّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ
verses.transliteration: Waanta hillun bihatha albaladi
verses.translation: And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city –

verses.text: وَوَالِدٖ وَمَا وَلَدَ
verses.transliteration: Wawalidin wama walada
verses.translation: And [by] the father[1924] and that which was born [of him],
verses.footnotes: [1924] Said to be Adam (upon him be peace) .

verses.text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِي كَبَدٍ
verses.transliteration: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee kabadin
verses.translation: We have certainly created man into hardship.

verses.text: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ
verses.transliteration: Ayahsabu an lan yaqdira AAalayhi ahadun
verses.translation: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?

verses.text: يَقُولُ أَهۡلَكۡتُ مَالٗا لُّبَدًا
verses.transliteration: Yaqoolu ahlaktu malan lubadan
verses.translation: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."

verses.text: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّمۡ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
verses.transliteration: Ayahsabu an lam yarahu ahadun
verses.translation: Does he think that no one has seen him?

verses.text: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ عَيۡنَيۡنِ
verses.transliteration: Alam najAAal lahu AAaynayni
verses.translation: Have We not made for him two eyes?

verses.text: وَلِسَانٗا وَشَفَتَيۡنِ
verses.transliteration: Walisanan washafatayni
verses.translation: And a tongue and two lips?

verses.text: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجۡدَيۡنِ
verses.transliteration: Wahadaynahu alnnajdayni
verses.translation: And have shown him the two ways?[1925]
verses.footnotes: [1925] Of good and evil.

verses.text: فَلَا ٱقۡتَحَمَ ٱلۡعَقَبَةَ
verses.transliteration: Fala iqtahama alAAaqabata
verses.translation: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.[1926]
verses.footnotes: [1926] i.e., the steep incline or obstacle. In other words, he has not spent in the cause of Allāh but only boasts of spending in front of others.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡعَقَبَةُ
verses.transliteration: Wama adraka ma alAAaqabatu
verses.translation: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?

verses.text: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
verses.transliteration: Fakku raqabatin
verses.translation: It is the freeing of a slave

verses.text: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمٞ فِي يَوۡمٖ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةٖ
verses.transliteration: Aw itAAamun fee yawmin thee masghabatin
verses.translation: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

verses.text: يَتِيمٗا ذَا مَقۡرَبَةٍ
verses.transliteration: Yateeman tha maqrabatin
verses.translation: An orphan of near relationship

verses.text: أَوۡ مِسۡكِينٗا ذَا مَتۡرَبَةٖ
verses.transliteration: Aw miskeenan tha matrabatin
verses.translation: Or a needy person in misery

verses.text: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ
verses.transliteration: Thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati
verses.translation: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.

verses.text: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ
verses.transliteration: Olaika ashabu almaymanati
verses.translation: Those are the companions of the right.[1927]
verses.footnotes: [1927] Or "the companions of good fortune," i.e., those who receive their records in their right hands and proceed to Paradise.

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
verses.transliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati
verses.translation: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.[1928]
verses.footnotes: [1928] Or "the companions of ill fortune," i.e., those who receive their records in their left hands and proceed to Hell.

verses.text: عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَارٞ مُّؤۡصَدَةُۢ
verses.transliteration: AAalayhim narun musadatun
verses.translation: Over them will be fire closed in.[1929]
verses.footnotes: [1929] The cover over Hell will be sealed and locked, containing its fire and its inhabitants.

verses.text: وَٱلشَّمۡسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Waalshshamsi waduhaha
verses.translation: By the sun and its brightness

verses.text: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Waalqamari itha talaha
verses.translation: And [by] the moon when it follows it

verses.text: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Waalnnahari itha jallaha
verses.translation: And [by] the day when it displays it[1931]
verses.footnotes: [1931] The earth. Also interpreted as the sun. The same applies to the following verse.

verses.text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Waallayli itha yaghshaha
verses.translation: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it

verses.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Waalssamai wama banaha
verses.translation: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

verses.text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Waalardi wama tahaha
verses.translation: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

verses.text: وَنَفۡسٖ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Wanafsin wama sawwaha
verses.translation: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it[1932]
verses.footnotes: [1932] i.e., balanced and refined it, creating in it sound tendencies and consciousness.

verses.text: فَأَلۡهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقۡوَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Faalhamaha fujooraha wataqwaha
verses.translation: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

verses.text: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Qad aflaha man zakkaha
verses.translation: He has succeeded who purifies it,

verses.text: وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Waqad khaba man dassaha
verses.translation: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

verses.text: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِطَغۡوَىٰهَآ
verses.transliteration: Kaththabat thamoodu bitaghwaha
verses.translation: Thamūd denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

verses.text: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشۡقَىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Ithi inbaAAatha ashqaha
verses.translation: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.[1933]
verses.footnotes: [1933] To hamstring the she-camel which had been sent by Allāh as a sign to them.

verses.text: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Faqala lahum rasoolu Allahi naqata Allahi wasuqyaha
verses.translation: And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."

verses.text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Fakaththaboohu faAAaqarooha fadamdama AAalayhim rabbuhum bithanbihim fasawwaha
verses.translation: But they denied him and hamstrung[1934] her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
verses.footnotes: [1934] And then killed.

verses.text: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقۡبَٰهَا
verses.transliteration: Wala yakhafu AAuqbaha
verses.translation: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.[1935]
verses.footnotes: [1935] Allāh is not asked about what He does, but His servants will be asked. See 21:23.

verses.text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waallayli itha yaghsha
verses.translation: By the night when it covers[1937]
verses.footnotes: [1937] With darkness.

verses.text: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waalnnahari itha tajalla
verses.translation: And [by] the day when it appears

verses.text: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Wama khalaqa alththakara waalontha
verses.translation: And [by] He who created the male and female,

verses.text: إِنَّ سَعۡيَكُمۡ لَشَتَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Inna saAAyakum lashatta
verses.translation: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.

verses.text: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أَعۡطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Faamma man aAAta waittaqa
verses.translation: As for he who gives and fears Allāh

verses.text: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wasaddaqa bialhusna
verses.translation: And believes in the best [reward].

verses.text: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fasanuyassiruhu lilyusra
verses.translation: We will ease him toward ease.

verses.text: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waamma man bakhila waistaghna
verses.translation: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

verses.text: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wakaththaba bialhusna
verses.translation: And denies the best [reward],

verses.text: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡعُسۡرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fasanuyassiruhu lilAAusra
verses.translation: We will ease him toward difficulty.

verses.text: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Wama yughnee AAanhu maluhu itha taradda
verses.translation: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?[1938]
verses.footnotes: [1938] i.e., when he dies or is destroyed. It can also mean when he falls into the Hellfire.

verses.text: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا لَلۡهُدَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Inna AAalayna lalhuda
verses.translation: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wainna lana lalakhirata waaloola
verses.translation: And indeed, to us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

verses.text: فَأَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ نَارٗا تَلَظَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Faanthartukum naran talaththa
verses.translation: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.

verses.text: لَا يَصۡلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى
verses.transliteration: La yaslaha illa alashqa
verses.translation: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Allathee kaththaba watawalla
verses.translation: Who had denied and turned away.

verses.text: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَتۡقَى
verses.transliteration: Wasayujannabuha alatqa
verses.translation: But the righteous one will avoid it –

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي يُؤۡتِي مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Allathee yutee malahu yatazakka
verses.translation: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

verses.text: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Wama liahadin AAindahu min niAAmatin tujza
verses.translation: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded[1939] –
verses.footnotes: [1939] i.e., without intending reciprocation for some benefit to himself.

verses.text: إِلَّا ٱبۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Illa ibtighaa wajhi rabbihi alaAAla
verses.translation: But only seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of his Lord, Most High.

verses.text: وَلَسَوۡفَ يَرۡضَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Walasawfa yarda
verses.translation: And he is going to be satisfied.

verses.text: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waaldduha
verses.translation: By the morning brightness

verses.text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waallayli itha saja
verses.translation: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,[1941]
verses.footnotes: [1941] And becomes still.

verses.text: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Ma waddaAAaka rabbuka wama qala
verses.translation: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you].

verses.text: وَلَلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Walalakhiratu khayrun laka mina aloola
verses.translation: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].

verses.text: وَلَسَوۡفَ يُعۡطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرۡضَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Walasawfa yuAAteeka rabbuka fatarda
verses.translation: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

verses.text: أَلَمۡ يَجِدۡكَ يَتِيمٗا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Alam yajidka yateeman faawa
verses.translation: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

verses.text: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلّٗا فَهَدَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wawajadaka dallan fahada
